textes.+2 d'endurance par point : courir, roule: +2 stamina per point: run, roll and climb for longer.

textes.Accomplir dix quêtes pour les habitants: Complete ten quests for the people of Port-Azur
textes.Accoster sur l'Île des Trois Soleils: Land on the Island of the Three Suns
textes.Accoster sur l'île des nains: Land on the island of the dwarves
textes.Accoster à Néopolis, sur le Quai des Dro: Land at Neopolis, on the Drone Quay
textes.Achille Buvard, le poète du village, a v: Achille Buvard, the village poet, saw the pot of orange (no. 7) stuck right at the top of the Ink Waterfall, on the Lip (the edge of the cliff, where the water falls). He gets dizzy with heights and with rhymes.
textes.Achille, vous écrivez sur la cascade ?: Achille, are you writing about the waterfall?
textes.Admirer la machine à bulles de Basile Bu: Admire Basile Bulle's bubble machine (Fair stand, west side)
textes.Agrafe et Pigment ont imprimé les affich: Agrafe and Pigment have printed the posters for the next Great Boucan. For the whole world to come, they must be taken to the other islands: to Paulo, in Port-Azur; to Ulric, the innkeeper of Montjoie; and to Tom the Fiddler, at the Crâne Fendu, on Balafre Island.
textes.Aller au Cercle des Pierres-Lunes (à l'o: Go to the Circle of Moonstones (west of the Academy) and lay your hand on the altar (E)
textes.Aller au Cirque du Crâne, au bout de la: Go to Skull Hollow, at the far end of Balafre, with the map: defeat Captain Fleshless, who guards the treasure
textes.Aller dire ses quatre vérités à Monsieur: Go and give Mr Fil a piece of your mind (at his stall in the Alleys, in the afternoon and evening)
textes.Aller saluer la Doyenne Astrée (à la Sal: Go and greet Elder Astrée (at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Spire, in the daytime; on her bench in the Agora during the Night of the Auroras)
textes.Aller voir Volt, l'ingénieur de l'énergi: Go and see Volt, the energy engineer (at the foot of the Crystal Spire, in the daytime and during the Night of the Auroras)
textes.Aller voir Zéro (sur la Place des Hologr: Go and see Zéro (on the Hologram Square in the daytime, at the quay in the evening)
textes.Allumer les cinq braseros de l'Aire des: Light the five braziers of the Duelling Ground in a row with the fireball (key 6 then V; in VR, left trigger), before the first one goes out
textes.Allumer les sept Grandes Lanternes de Pa: Light the seven Great Lanterns of Pandémonia with the ember lantern (the port, the market, the arena, the baths, the Academy, the Forge Cathedral, the Great Lantern Square)
textes.Annoncer la victoire à Pépin, à la Clair: Tell Pépin about the victory, at the Games Clearing
textes.Annoncer à Matthias que la Porte aux Qua: Tell Matthias that the Gate of the Four Seals is open (Carène harbour master's office)
textes.Apaiser le Gardien du Cœur: Calm the Guardian of the Heart
textes.Apporter 2 dorades à Zohra, à la criée d: Bring 2 sea bream to Zohra, at the Tazira fish market (use a fishing rod, at the end of the jetty for example)
textes.Apporter 3 minerais de fer au professeur: Bring 3 iron ore to Professor Boum, in front of his workshop (west of Cliquetis, near the cliffs)
textes.Apporter la puce holographique et la car: Bring the hologram chip and the star chart to Ionie (in the Spaceport hangar)
textes.Apporter le miel à Bobor, au Four Éterne: Bring the honey to Bobor, at the Eternal Oven (the bakery in the Great Market)
textes.Apporter les cinq bouquets à Xóchitl (su: Bring the five bouquets to Xóchitl (on the chinampas, or at the market)
textes.Apporter les cinq fleurs à Mère Brasille: Bring the five flowers to Mother Brasille (at the Ash Gardens)
textes.Apporter les cordes et la toile à Jack (: Bring the ropes and the canvas to Jack (in the Festival Meadow, in front of the Main Stage, in the daytime)
textes.Apporter les trois champignons à Mère Sa: Bring the three mushrooms to Mother Sage (at the herb garden, south of the Academy)
textes.Apporter les trois cristaux à Violette (: Bring the three crystals to Violette (at a Guild table, or at the Upper Town lookout in the afternoon)
textes.Apporter les trois cristaux à Zigomar (à: Bring the three crystals to Zigomar (at his inventor's workshop)
textes.Apporter les trois flocons à Borée Givre: Bring the three flakes to Borée Givrelin (on the shore of Mirror Lake, north-east of the Academy)
textes.Apporter les trois fragments à Zénith (à: Bring the three fragments to Zénith (at the Observatory, on the islet to the north, across the bridge of light; he sleeps in the morning and works from evening until dawn)
textes.Apporter les trois lots de pièces à Rust: Bring the three batches of parts to Rustine (at the Spinning Mill bike workshop)
textes.Apporter les trois paniers à Lentille (à: Bring the three baskets to Lentille (at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen, on the ground floor of the Cannery)
textes.Apporter les trois plumes à Zéphyrine Pl: Bring the three feathers to Zéphyrine Plume (at the foot of the Leaning Tower, in the south of the island)
textes.Apporter les trois touffes au Doc (Fulbe: Bring the three tufts to the Doc (Fulbert Saignée, in front of his door, near the forge)
textes.Apporter les trois éclats de lune à Auré: Bring the three moon shards to Aurélien Lumen (near the Observatory, north-west of the Academy; at the library in the afternoon)
textes.Apporter trois bûches à Pyra Flammèche (: Bring three logs to Pyra Flammèche (at the Duelling Ground, east of the Academy)
textes.Apporter un cristal de soufre à Mademois: Bring a sulphur crystal to Miss Sulfura (at the Academy; Bulle sells them at the Sulphur Baths)
textes.Apporter une galette de maïs à Kinich (I: Bring a corn cake to Kinich (Ix Chab sells them on the square of Yaxché)
textes.Apporter à Clémence un corail rouge (fon: Bring Clémence a red coral (bottom of the bay, to the west), some honey and a coconut
textes.Apporter à Hector deux bûches et trois c: Bring Hector two logs and three pebbles
textes.Apporter à Ionie trois cristaux astraux,: Bring Ionie three astral crystals, two meteorite fragments, four gears and two rolls of sailcloth (Ionie and Nébula sell them; fragments also fall on shooting-star nights) — Ionie is in the Spaceport hangar, to the east
textes.Apporter à Lord Pemberton une plume de V: Bring Lord Pemberton one of Ventaile's feathers, a naga scale or a shark tooth
textes.Apporter à Volt les trois éclats et troi: Bring Volt the three shards and three astral crystals (at the foot of the Crystal Spire)
textes.Apprendre la télékinésie avec Théophrast: Learn telekinesis with Théophraste Filandre, at the library
textes.Apprendre les six sorts des maîtres d'Ar: Learn the six spells of the masters of Arcanelle: light, fire, frost, levitation, telekinesis and healing
textes.Après un coup d'arme, garde le clic enfo: After a weapon blow, keep the button held: the blade charges up (it glows). Release: a terrible blow (×2.5). In VR: a very fast swing.
textes.Arbre marqué d'une entaille : il s'abat: Tree marked with a notch: chop it down with an axe
textes.Assister à la Nuit des Aurores: Watch the Night of the Auroras
textes.Assister à la Nuit des Aurores (chaque n: Watch the Night of the Auroras (every night from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m., above Astralys: watch it from the Agora, or better still, from the Observatory)
textes.Astralys, l'île flottante des Lumens: Astralys, the floating island of the Lumens
textes.Atteindre l'île flottante et sa citadell: Reach the floating island and its citadel
textes.Au sommet du Grand Temple, offrir une ja: At the top of the Great Temple, offer a jar of rain to Tlaloc (blue shrine) and copal to Huitzilopochtli (red shrine)
textes.Au sommet du Temple de Kukulkan, mettre: At the top of the Temple of Kukulkan, set the two calendar wheels to the date of the creation of the world (the great stele on the square shows it; Ah Kin, the astronomer, knows it)
textes.Aucun pour l'instant. Rendez service, et: None yet. Help people out, and they will remember it.
textes.Aucune pour l'instant. La première t'att: None yet. The first one may be waiting for you under the village…
textes.Aucune quête en cours. Parlez aux habita: No quest in progress. Talk to the locals: many of them need help.
textes.Aurélien Lumen m'apprendra le sort de lu: Aurélien Lumen will teach me the light spell if I bring him three moon shards that fell on the island. Then I'll have to awaken the runes in the Crypt.
textes.Basile Pinceau, le peintre du village, a: Basile Pinceau, the village painter, saw the pot of blue (no. 1) floating on the Rubbed-Out Pond the day after the Great Downpour. It got stuck on a giant water lily, far from the bank. Basile swims like a stone.
textes.Basile, qu'est-ce que vous regardez dans: Basile, what are you looking at in the pond?
textes.Battre son record à Dragon-Pixel: Beat your high score at Dragon-Pixel
textes.Bedaine, le tanuki du Marché aux trocs,: Bedaine, the tanuki of the Barter Market, wants to teach you the Great Swap: a pebble that, swap after swap, becomes a treasure.
textes.Bernard défie quiconque de courir de la: Bernard challenges anyone to run from the fountain to the lighthouse in under a minute.
textes.Biscotte, un petit rat blanc et brun, vi: Biscotte, a little white and brown rat, lives in the hold of the Requin Borgne. He's the secret friend of Petit-Pierre, the cabin boy. But Mange-Clous, the cook, has sworn to throw him overboard: his cheeses keep disappearing. Petit-Pierre would like Biscotte to go off with someone kind before it's too late. To lure him out of the hold, you need aged cheese.
textes.Borée Givrelin m'apprendra le gel si je: Borée Givrelin will teach me frost if I bring him three everlasting frost flakes from the northern cliffs. Then I'll have to cross the Mirror Lake to the Frost Crystal.
textes.Brindille, la factrice ailée, s'est foul: Brindille, the winged postwoman, has sprained a wing. There are three letters left to deliver: to Grumbald, the innkeeper, to Ombreline, the librarian, and to Gorgoth, the arena champion.
textes.Briser le sceau des Abysses: Break the seal of the Abyss
textes.Brutus, le forgeron de Port-Coutelas, me: Brutus, the blacksmith of Port-Coutelas, will forge me an iron fist if I bring him three crocodile teeth from the Drowned Marsh.
textes.C'est quoi, votre programme exceptionnel: So what's this exceptional programme of yours?
textes.Capucine Buvard, la fleuriste, a vu un l: Capucine Buvard, the florist, saw a rabbit roll the pot of red (no. 3) towards Mr Paille, the scarecrow, in the middle of the White Meadows. But the grass is tall, and Capucine is scared of rabbits.
textes.Capucine, pourquoi ces fleurs sont-elles: Capucine, why are these flowers all white?
textes.Ce poing de fer, tu me le forges ?: That iron fist… will you forge it for me?
textes.Ces crocodiles… je peux t'aider ?: Those crocodiles… can I help you?
textes.Chaque nuit, Rê traverse le monde d'en d: Every night, Ra crosses the underworld in his boat, and Apophis, the serpent of chaos, wants to swallow him. Since the Pyramid of Ra was sealed, Néferet no longer hears Ra singing at dawn.
textes.Chaque pouvoir lancé rend de l'endurance: Every power you cast gives back stamina; every four powers, half a heart.
textes.Chaque printemps, les navets de Père Gau: Every spring, Père Gaubert's turnips wake up and run off across the Southern Fields. With his bad knees, he can't catch a single one any more. He'd like five golden turnips, caught during a Great Turnip Alert.
textes.Charge plus longtemps (la lueur devient: Charge longer (the glow turns blue): when you release, you spin and strike all around you, twice. In VR: click the right stick.
textes.Charger remplace la partie en cours : pe: Loading replaces the current game: remember to save first.
textes.Chasser le virus de ton carnet : casser: Chase the virus out of your journal: break its three locks on the screen (if you take a break, Glitch helps you pick up again: near the Arcade Station in the morning and evening, in the arcade in the afternoon)
textes.Chasser les chiens d'enfer sauvages du c: Drive the wild hellhounds out of the lava field (east of the Great Blaze)
textes.Chasser les gargouilles des Ruines de l': Drive the gargoyles out of the Ruins of the Old Pandemonium (on the north-western cliffs of the island)
textes.Chasser les grenouilles géantes du Lac d: Hunt the giant frogs of the Frog Lake (east of Montjoie, through the East Gate; watch out for their tongues, they swallow you up)

Hunt the giant frogs of the Frog Lake (east of town, through the East Gate): the biggest one, the Duchess, will give back the sun rosary; then bring it back to Sister Pétronille (at the Temple of Dawn, in the Upper Town, or at the Guild in the afternoon)
textes.Chercher Miou sur le plateau de Rê, près: Look for Miou on the plateau of Ra, near the mastabas (the square tombs), and pick him up in your arms (E)
textes.Chercher Pépin dans le Bois de Cendre (a: Look for Pépin in the Ash Wood (south-east of the city, under the ember trees) and call him (E)
textes.Choisis un talent pour le lire. Les tale: Pick a talent to read it. The talents of a branch are learned in order, from top to bottom.
textes.Cinq cents mètres de corde de chanvre, e: Five hundred metres of hemp rope, tightly coiled. Each end is closed with a funny knot: the friendship knot, says Galet. The harder you pull, the tighter it holds.
textes.Clémence veut peindre avec des couleurs: Clémence wants to paint with natural colours: a red coral from the bottom of the bay, some honey and a coconut.
textes.Comment devenir citoyen de Port-Azur ?: How do I become a citizen of Port-Azur?
textes.Comète, la pilote de soucoupe, s'ennuie: Comète, the saucer pilot, is bored: nobody wants to race her. Now that you have the Star Glider, she challenges you: first a practice run on the ring course of the Zero-Gravity Garden, then the great ring race in the sky, around Astralys.
textes.Comète, tu cherches un adversaire ?: Comète, are you looking for an opponent?
textes.Couleurs de Gaston, en poisson. On ne le: Gaston's colours, as a fish. Found only in the jungle bay. Restores two hearts.
textes.Courir coûte deux fois moins d'endurance: Running costs half the stamina, and you run 10% faster.
textes.Courir de la fontaine de la place à la p: Run from the fountain on the square to the lighthouse door in under 60 seconds
textes.Coyotl, le potier d'Aztlán, façonne les: Coyotl, the potter of Aztlán, shapes Tlaloc's rain jars; but he only gives one away if the high priest sends you to ask.
textes.Creuser (pelle en main) là où l'ombre du: Dig (shovel in hand) where the shadow of the Houseboat's mast touches the sea at noon: on the sand, between the mast and the water
textes.Creuser le sable près de la paillote, au: Dig in the sand near the beach hut, at the water's edge (shovel in hand)
textes.Croquer un piment infernal devant le Pro: Bite into an infernal chili in front of Professor Malachar (Zébuline sells them at the Great Market)
textes.Cuauhtli, le grand prêtre d'Aztlán, cher: Cuauhtli, the high priest of Aztlán, is looking for someone to offer rain to Tlaloc and fire to Huitzilopochtli at the top of the Great Temple, and to go down beneath the temple, into the hall of the Five Suns.
textes.Cueillir cinq bouquets de cempasúchil su: Pick five bouquets of cempasúchil on the chinampas, south and west of the lake of Aztlán
textes.Cueillir cinq fleurs de braise sur les p: Pick five ember flowers on the slopes of the Great Blaze (away from the lava flows)
textes.Cueillir les cinq champignons de lune, a: Pick the five moon mushrooms at the edge of the forest ponds around Ramure (the big pond west of the Circle, the pond in the Games Clearing, and the ones to the west, south and north)
textes.Cueillir trois champignons des bois dans: Pick three wild mushrooms in the Twisted Wood (south-west of the island)
textes.Cueillir trois touffes d'herbe à fièvre: Pick three tufts of feverweed at the water's edge in the Drowned Marsh (west of the island)
textes.Cueillir un Arc-en-ciel, aux lamelles de: Pick a Rainbow, with gills of every colour (in the Spore Cathedral)
textes.Cueillir un Babillard, qui fait de petit: Pick a Chatterbox, which makes little noises when you come near (in the Spore Cathedral)
textes.Cueillir un Bolet-Ressort, au chapeau or: Pick a Spring-Bolete, with its bouncy orange cap (in the Spore Cathedral, the old gasholder south of the town)
textes.Cueillir un Petit-Géant, minuscule mais: Pick a Little-Giant, tiny but very proud (in the Spore Cathedral)
textes.Cueillir un bouquet de tournesols dans l: Pick a bunch of sunflowers in Granny Sunflower's garden (in the Flower Camp, south-west of the campfire)
textes.Cueillir une Lunaire, pâle et argentée (: Pick a Moonling, pale and silvery (in the Spore Cathedral)
textes.Danser le pogo à un concert de la Halle: Join the mosh pit at a Howling Hall concert
textes.Danser à la Nuit des Lanternes: Dance at the Night of Lanterns
textes.De la brume du matin, cueillie sur la gr: Morning mist, gathered over the big pond and bottled by Pivoine. It swirls gently behind the glass.
textes.De plus en plus souvent, les robots démé: More and more often, Mr Lisse's mover robots land on the quays to clear out the squats. Mamie Barricade would like you to help the Boucan fight off the next Movers' Raid.
textes.Demander conseil à Perroquet-Joe (son ét: Ask Perroquet-Joe for advice (his stall is on the square of Port-Coutelas, near the well)
textes.Demander des pâtes fraîches à Mamma Lasa: Ask Mamma Lasagna for fresh pasta (at the Pasta Drying Shed in the daytime, at the oven on the Borgo's little piazza at noon and in the evening)
textes.Demander la Clé du Brasier à Frère Cendr: Ask Brother Cendrin for the Brasier key (in the Forge Cathedral, near the Ember Heart)
textes.Demander un grimoire à Théophraste Filan: Ask Théophraste Filandre for a spellbook, at the library (the big slate building, on the way up to the Academy)
textes.Demander une carte stellaire à Sextant (: Ask Sextant for a star chart (in the morning on the Gate lookout, around noon at the Museum, in the afternoon on the Observatory bridge, in the Gardens or at the Spaceport)
textes.Demander à Cargo, le grand androïde dock: Ask Cargo, the big docker android on the Drone Quay (north of the city), if he has a Z-Series voice chip
textes.Demander à Cuauhtli, le grand prêtre (au: Ask Cuauhtli, the high priest (at the foot of the Great Temple), to send you to Coyotl
textes.Demander à Lucas, le docker, le nom de s: Ask Lucas the docker the name of his boat
textes.Demander à Pépé Fernand le nom de sa bar: Ask Grandpa Fernand the name of his boat (on the quay, to the east)
textes.Demander à Sextant s'il a vu Plume-de-Nu: Ask Sextant if he has seen Plume-de-Nuage (he sketches on the Gate lookout in the morning, at the Museum around noon, then on the Observatory bridge, in the Gardens or at the Spaceport)
textes.Demander à Yannick le nom de ses bateaux: Ask Yannick the names of his boats (boat hire, on the quay)
textes.Depuis une semaine, le Grand Spaghetti V: For a week now, the Great Flying Spaghetti has been sulking: its noodles droop, its eyes stay half-shut, and the volcano rumbles more than usual. The Reverend Father Farfalle has found the recipe that will make it friends again with its followers: the Great Reconciliation dish. It needs Mamma Lasagna's pasta, a ladleful of sauce from the Cooking Pot and parmesan grated with Captain Rigatoni's Golden Grater (which he buried somewhere thirty years ago).
textes.Des chaussettes chauffées par une mini-c: Socks warmed by a mini-boiler at the ankle. Ideal for the highlands.
textes.Des chiens d'enfer sauvages ont pris le: Wild hellhounds have taken over the lava field, east of the Great Blaze, and growl at travellers. Captain Pyrus would like someone to drive them away.
textes.Des dattes de l'oasis, apportées par la: Dates from the oasis, brought by Mbarek's caravan: brown, glossy, sweet as honey. Restores one heart.
textes.Des fleurs d'œillet d'Inde, orange comme: Marigold flowers, orange like the setting sun, picked on the chinampas. Their scent, they say, guides souls. Xóchitl needs them.
textes.Des gargouilles se sont réveillées dans: Gargoyles have woken up in the Ruins of the Old Pandemonium, on the north-western cliffs. They swoop down on passing ships. Captain Charbonnel, the harbour master, would like someone to drive them away.
textes.Des graines de tournesol grillées au sel: Salted roasted sunflower seeds, in a little cloth bag. Perroquet-Joe swears no parrot can resist them.
textes.Des lunettes dont les verres sont des ka: Glasses whose lenses are kaleidoscopes. The whole world becomes a rose window.
textes.Des perches des mares grillées sur une b: Pond perch grilled on a bamboo stick by Caramel, the fishmonger. Crispy. Restores two hearts.
textes.Descendre au cinquième étage du Donjon d: Go down to the fifth floor of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.Descendre au port de Cliquetis (téléphér: Go down to the harbour of Cliquetis (cable car or winding road) and find the golden gear, near the crane
textes.Descendre dans Xibalba, déjouer les Seig: Go down into Xibalba, outwit the Lords of Death and bring back the Jade Mask
textes.Descendre dans la Pyramide de Rê, traver: Go down into the Pyramid of Ra, cross the journey of the night and defeat Apophis at the bottom of the Duat
textes.Descendre dans les Neuf Cercles (la port: Go down into the Nine Circles (the iron door at the back of the Forge Cathedral), defeat the Frost Titan at the bottom of the Cocytus and bring back the Eternal Flame
textes.Descendre les cinq étages du Donjon des: Go down the five floors of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps (the entrance is under the ruined tower, at the foot of the Fangs, in the south-west of the island; Odon keeps the gate) and defeat the Jelly King in the Jelly Throne Room
textes.Descendre sous le Cœur-de-Pierre, dans l: Go down beneath Stoneheart, into the Rose of Seals
textes.Descendre sous le Grand Temple, rallumer: Go down beneath the Great Temple, rekindle the Sun Stone, set the Fifth Sun in motion, defeat Cipactli
textes.Deux cœurs rendus ; le sort soigne aussi: Two hearts restored; the spell also heals wounded creatures.
textes.Deux gros os, rongés et luisants. Les ja: Two big bones, gnawed and shiny. The jaguars of the hills fight over them; throw them to a jaguar, and it will forget to bite you.
textes.Deux vrais jaguars rôdent sur les pentes: Two real jaguars are prowling the slopes of the Smoking Mountain, to the west. They killed one of Xóchitl's turkeys. Mixtli, the jaguar warrior, wants someone to face them.
textes.Dire à Mégaphone que c'est le moment (à: Tell Mégaphone it's time (at the sound desk, in the middle of the meadow)
textes.Dix poissons, du safran et le secret de: Ten fish, saffron and the secret of Paulo's nonna. Restores all hearts.
textes.Donner les baguettes de batterie à Gédéo: Give the drumsticks to Gédéon (at the Lisse & Fils sales office in the daytime, on the quays in the late afternoon, at the entrance to the Howling Hall in the evening)
textes.Donner un coup de pinceau (le Pinceau de: Make a brushstroke (the island's Brush, dipped in the Palette)
textes.Donner votre avis à Héloïse Manivelle, d: Give your opinion to Héloïse Manivelle, in front of the Academy
textes.Doyenne, pourquoi les ponts de lumière c: Elder, why are the bridges of light flickering?
textes.Du bon bois, coupé à la hache. Octave en: Good wood, cut with the axe. Octave buys it for his forge.
textes.Du cacao battu jusqu'à mousser, avec un: Cocoa whisked until frothy, with a little chilli and vanilla: the drink of the Maya kings, bitter and invigorating. Restores one heart.
textes.Du slime remonte dans les puits de la Ba: Slime is rising in the wells of the Lower Town and in the fountain on the Great Square. Master Hugues knows where it comes from: from the bottom of the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps, at the foot of the Fangs, where the Jelly King reigns. I have to go down the five floors, defeat the King and bring back his Royal jelly heart.
textes.Du verre de volcan, noir et tranchant, q: Volcanic glass, black and sharp, found near the crater. Nori the runesmith carves his runes into it.
textes.Dégager l'éboulement de la galerie sous: Clear the rockfall in the tunnel under the sea
textes.Entrer dans Pandémonia, la cité aux mill: Enter Pandémonia, the city of a thousand lanterns
textes.Entrer dans Yggdrasil par la porte aux r: Enter Yggdrasil through the rune door
Enter Yggdrasil through the rune door, cross its three halls to the Crown and receive the seed
textes.Entrer dans l'Usine Grise (au sud-est de: Enter the Grey Factory (in the south-east of the island, behind the Spore Wood), go down the five floors and defeat the Great Digger in the President's Pit
textes.Entrer dans la cité de cristal et de lum: Enter the city of crystal and light
textes.Entrer dans la cité sous la montagne: Enter the city under the mountain
textes.Entrer dans le Rocher du Crâne par sa bo: Enter Skull Rock through its mouth and open Barbe-Sanglante's chest (E)
textes.Essayer le Glisseur stellaire : l'appele: Try out the Star Glider: call it, climb aboard and fly off above Astralys
textes.Et si on retrouvait les quatre sceaux ?: What if we found the four seals?
textes.Faire la connaissance de Pip, le plus je: Meet Pip, the youngest of the apprentices (in the Academy courtyard in the morning, on the village square in the evening)
textes.Faire le tour de la ville en monorail (l: Ride the monorail around the city (all four stations)
textes.Faire les offrandes du Grand Temple d'Az: Make the offerings at the Great Temple of Aztlán
textes.Faire redescendre les quatre livres envo: Bring the four runaway books back down with telekinesis (key 9 then V, aiming at the book; in VR, left trigger): on the library roof, on the highest Moonstone of the Circle, at a window of the Leaning Tower and in a big oak in the Twisted Wood
textes.Faire siffler l'ampli (l'effet Larsen): Make the amp squeal (the Larsen effect)
textes.Faire tourner la vieille vanne de la gra: Turn the old sluice valve of Ramure's big pond with the Cog (key 3 then X; in VR, B), then, at night, take the Seal of Mists from the round stone at the bottom of the pond
textes.Faites glisser pour déplacer, molette po: Drag to move, mouse wheel to zoom.
textes.Fer forgé par Octave. En main, clic (gâc: Iron forged by Octave. In hand, click (trigger in VR) to dig in sand or earth: shells, coins… and sometimes a treasure.
textes.Firmin Cogne a perdu l'engrenage d'or de: Firmin Cogne lost the golden gear of his perpetual-motion engine during a demonstration. It rolled all the way down the cliffs, towards the harbour.
textes.Forgefer, la cité des nains: Forgefer, the city of the dwarves
textes.Forgé par Brutus, trois dents de crocodi: Forged by Brutus, with three crocodile teeth set in the iron. As long as it's in your bag, your punches hit harder in brawls (+1). Fists only.
textes.Forgé par Hector à l'Enclume Bleue : lam: Forged by Hector at L'Enclume Bleue: a curved blade of blued steel, with a brass shell guard. Damage: 10, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard.
textes.Forgée par Borin Barbe-de-Fer dans l'aci: Forged by Borin Barbe-de-Fer from volcano steel: a short, broad blade, a golden guard, a ruby on the pommel. Damage: 9, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard.
textes.Fouiller les caisses au bout du quai, cô: Search the crates at the end of the quay, on the lighthouse side
textes.Frapper à la porte des quatre maisons: Knock on the doors of the four houses
textes.Gagner la Grande Course : prendre le dép: Win the Great Race: start under the arch of the Games Clearing (E), pass under the ten arches in order and come back first
textes.Gagner le troisième morceau contre Sylva: Win the third piece from Sylvain (three wins in a row at the big table of the Shark's Tooth), then take the three pieces to Philémon Lunette, the mapmaker (in front of his tower)
textes.Gagner les quatre manches du Tournoi des: Win the four rounds of the Tournament of Horns (strike the gong, at the edge of the arena sand)
textes.Gaspard Fusain, le guetteur du Belvédère: Gaspard Fusain, the lookout of the Belvedere, saw a little glint shining at the top of Mount Charcoal through his telescope. He thinks it's the pot of purple (no. 6). He'd like you to look for yourself, then go and fetch it.
textes.Glorb, le touriste de la planète Gloop,: Glorb, the tourist from the planet Gloop, would like to send his mum photos from the four corners of the archipelago. But he's green and wobbly, and he's afraid of scaring the people down below. He gives you his holo-photo: you need to photograph the mayor of Port-Azur, Mama Grog in Balafre, the Baron of Montjoie and Mamie Barricade in the Boucan, then bring the camera back to him.
textes.Glorb, pourquoi tu photographies tout ?: Glorb, why do you photograph everything?
textes.Gontran Lestrange, dit Jambe-de-Bois, le: Gontran Lestrange, known as Jambe-de-Bois, captain of the Veuve Écarlate, has owed Mama Grog forty coins for three moons. She wants his purse.
textes.Gorgée d'eau, avec une algue en prime. Q: Soaked through, with a bonus piece of seaweed. Somebody, somewhere, has a cold foot.
textes.Goûter la sauce du volcan avec la louche: Taste the volcano's sauce with the giant ladle
textes.Goûter le néo-ramen du robot du Marché d: Taste the robot's neo-ramen at the Night Market
textes.Goûter le thé stellaire de Gloubi (au Ca: Taste Gloubi's star tea (at the Nebula Café, west of the Agora of Stars)
textes.Grand-Mère Aquarelle, pourquoi l'île est: Grand-Mère Aquarelle, why is the island all grey?
textes.Grand-père Ébène raconte que Cerbère, le: Grandpa Ébène says that Cerberus, the three-headed dog of the Nine Circles, can't resist honey cakes: one per head. Bobor, the baker, is happy to bake three… if he has honey.
textes.Grimper au Belvédère des Couleurs, en ha: Climb to the Lookout of Colours, at the top of the Great Oak
textes.Grimper au sommet des Crocs (les colline: Climb to the top of the Fangs (the rocky hills in the south-west, above the dungeon entrance) and pick up three storm crystals
textes.Gédéon, le fils de Monsieur Lisse, tapot: Gédéon, Mr Lisse's son, taps out rhythms on everything he touches. Every evening, he listens to the Bilge Rats from behind the door of the Howling Hall. He's a brilliant drummer, but he has neither drumsticks nor courage. As for the drumsticks, you've kept them since the Great Boucan

Gédéon, Mr Lisse's son, taps out rhythms on everything he touches. Every evening, he listens to the Bilge Rats from behind the door of the Howling Hall. He's a brilliant drummer, but he has neither drumsticks nor courage. As for the drumsticks, you've kept them since the Great Boucan…
textes.Gédéon, pourquoi vous tapotez toujours ?: Gédéon, why are you always tapping?
textes.Gérard Dupuis a oublié son appareil phot: Gérard Dupuis left his camera at the lookout, at the top of the hill.
textes.Halo, comment devient-on visiteur d'Astr: Halo, how does one become a visitor to Astralys?
textes.Halo, le gardien du Portail d'accueil, v: Halo, the keeper of the Welcome Gate, wants you to become an official visitor of Astralys, as tradition demands: get yourself entered in the register by Écliptique, taste the star tea at Gloubi's, then go and greet Elder Astrée.
textes.Hisser le panier de la poulie du Grand-C: Hoist the basket on the Great Oak's pulley
textes.Hisser le panier de la poulie, sur la pl: Hoist the pulley basket, on the Great Oak platform, next to the Council House (or look inside it, down at the foot of the tree)
textes.Honorine est seule au four ce matin. Il: Honorine is alone at the oven this morning. There are three loaves left to deliver: one to Mamie Rissole, at the Guild tavern; one to Aurore, at the castle; one to Gilles, at the North Gate. If she leaves the oven, everything burns.
textes.Hugo a perdu son alliance dans le sable,: Hugo has lost his wedding ring in the sand, near the Coco Loco beach hut, where the waves come in.
textes.Héloïse Manivelle, ingénieure-en-chef, p: Héloïse Manivelle, chief engineer, chairs the jury of the Inventions Fair. She needs the opinion of an unbiased visitor.
textes.Il brille au soleil. Un marchand en voud: It shines in the sun. A merchant might want it.
textes.Il pousse à l'ombre des grands arbres. R: It grows in the shade of the tall trees. Restores half a heart.
textes.Il y a dix jours, la Grande Averse (une: Ten days ago, the Great Downpour (a shower of clear water from a pure white cloud) washed over Sketched Island: the Stone Palette overflowed, and the island's nine pots of colour were carried off by the water to the four corners of the island. Since then, everything has been black and white. Grandma Aquarelle, the village elder, has entrusted you with the island's Brush. You need to find the nine pots and pour each one into its numbered paint well.
textes.Interroger Bruno, le glacier de la prome: Question Bruno, the ice-cream seller on the promenade
textes.Ionie, la mécanicienne du Spatioport, rê: Ionie, the Spaceport mechanic, dreams of turning the hero's aircraft (the Albatros, built in Cliquetis) into a Star Glider: a fast little saucer that can climb very high and land on Astralys. She needs materials, a hologram chip for navigation (which flew off from Professor Quasar's laboratory) and a star chart drawn by Sextant.
textes.Ionie, vous pourriez améliorer ma machin: Ionie, could you upgrade my flying machine?
textes.Jack, Mamie Tournesol dit que le festiva: Jack, Granny Sunflower says the festival is coming back!
textes.Je peux courir la Grande Course ?: Can I run the Great Race?
textes.Je peux t'aider pour la fièvre ?: Can I help with the fever?
textes.Je peux vous aider pour la fête ?: Can I help you with the festival?
textes.Je peux vous aider pour le tajine ?: Can I help you with the tagine?
textes.Je veux m'inscrire au tournoi !: I want to enter the tournament!
textes.Je voudrais m'inscrire à la Guilde !: I'd like to join the Guild!
textes.Kevin met au défi de remonter trois étoi: Kevin challenges you to bring up three starfish from the bottom of the bay.
textes.Kinich, le garçon au moustique, veut bie: Kinich, the boy with the mosquito, is willing to lend Xan, his mosquito, to whoever goes down into Xibalba. But he's hungry.
textes.L'Alouette, le deltaplane de Philibert (: The Alouette, Philibert's hang glider (at the Wing Workshop, west of Cliquetis)
textes.L'archimage Séraphine Astrelune veut bie: Archmage Séraphine Astrelune is willing to take me on as an apprentice. I need a spellbook, and to get to know the other apprentices.
textes.L'eau du bassin de la grande chute, dans: Water from the pool of the great waterfall, in the crystal vial. It sparkles a little, as if it were holding stars.
textes.L'entraînement : faire le parcours d'ann: Training: complete the glowing ring course in the Zero-Gravity Garden (to the west, at the end of the bridge of light) and set a record
textes.L'horloge de la place est arrêtée : il l: The clock on the square has stopped: it needs a new cogwheel, which only Hector can forge.
textes.L'hydromel de Berthe, au Chaudron Fumant: Berthe's honey drink, at Le Chaudron Fumant: made with honey from Mother Sauge's hives, sweet and golden. Restores one heart.
textes.L'objet que tu vises, même hors de porté: The item you aim at, even out of reach, flies into your hand.
textes.L'orange de la Cascade d'Encre: The orange of the Ink Waterfall
textes.L'Île Al Dente, au sud-ouest de l'archip: Al Dente Island, in the south-west of the archipelago
textes.L'Île Al Dente, l'île du Spaghetti Volan: Al Dente Island, the island of the Flying Spaghetti
textes.L'Île Al Dente, le Temple-Passoire: Al Dente Island, the Colander Temple
textes.L'Île Crayonnée, au sud-est de l'archipe: Sketched Island, in the south-east of the archipelago
textes.L'Île Crayonnée, l'île sans couleurs: Sketched Island, the island without colours
textes.L'Île Crayonnée, le Belvédère des Couleu: Sketched Island, the Lookout of Colours
textes.L'Île aux Moaïs, l'escalier du Grand Moa: Moai Island, the stairway of the Great Moai
textes.L'Île aux Moaïs, la Salle du Chant: Moai Island, the Hall of Song
textes.L'Île aux Moaïs, le Cœur du Chant: Moai Island, the Heart of the Song
textes.L'Île de Larsen, chez le Disquaire: Larsen Island, at the Record Shop
textes.L'Île des Trois Soleils: The Island of the Three Suns
textes.L'épée des Rois-Ciel, trouvée dans le tr: The sword of the Sky Kings, found in the treasure of the Storm Tower. Its blade crackles with little blue sparks. Damage: 12, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard.
textes.La Flamme brûle plus fort, la Bourrasque: The Flame burns hotter, the Gust blows wider, the Moonglow lasts longer, the Cog turns longer.
textes.La Porte aux Quatre Sceaux: The Gate of the Four Seals
textes.La bière épaisse et douce de Mérit, fait: Mérit's thick, sweet barley drink, made with barley bread and dates. The Egyptians drank it like liquid bread. Restores one heart.
textes.La boisson du Diable Repu, sans alcool :: The house drink of Au Diable Repu, alcohol-free: honey, fire cinnamon, a pinch of sulphur from the springs (for the colour). It smells of eggs, and it warms you right through. Restores one heart.
textes.La brioche du Four Éternel de Bobor, dor: The brioche from Bobor's Eternal Oven, golden, split on top, baked over the embers that never go out. Still warm, at any hour. Restores two hearts.
textes.La cloche de la Tour Penchée: The bell of the Leaning Tower
textes.La clé d'or de la ville, remise par le m: The golden key to the town, given by the mayor to the honorary citizen. It opens no doors, but every heart.
textes.La couronne des Rois-Ciel : or blanc, sa: The crown of the Sky Kings: white gold, sapphires and cloud pearls. Proof that you defeated Lord Storm. It's worth a fortune… but who would dare sell it?
textes.La dernière pluie d'étoiles filantes a f: The last shower of shooting stars cracked three lenses of Zénith's great telescope. To cast new ones, he needs three meteorite fragments that fell on the island that night. After that, he'd like to show you the Night of the Auroras through the repaired telescope.
textes.La fameuse tourte de Mamie Rissole, la c: Mamie Rissole's famous pie (she's the Guild's cook): a golden crust, vegetables, mushrooms, melted cheese, and a secret she has never told anyone. Master Hugues eats three a day. Restores three hearts.
textes.La fierté de Gustave Fiole, à L'Alambic: The pride of Gustave Fiole, at L'Alambic: moon dew, three drops of honey and a kind thought. It restores six points of magic.
textes.La fièvre des marais a couché la moitié: Marsh fever has laid up half the crew of the Veuve Écarlate. The Doc needs three tufts of feverweed, which grow at the water's edge in the Drowned Marsh.
textes.La galette complète de Mère Gwenola : sa: Mother Gwenola's complete galette: buckwheat, salted butter, an egg in the middle, cooked on the billig griddle at La Dernière Bordée. Restores two hearts.
textes.La grande course : retrouver Comète au-d: The great race: meet Comète above the Spaceport, aboard the Star Glider, and fly through all the sky rings around Astralys before she does
textes.La grande lentille du phare a perdu un m: The lighthouse's big lens has lost a piece, which fell into the sea at the foot of the point.
textes.La grande toile que Lune a mis trois ans: The great canvas that Lune spent three years weaving, rolled up like a carpet. Inside, you can make out a sun, a cloud and a rainbow. It's as heavy as a sleeping donkey.
textes.La guitare électrique de Clou, rouge cer: Clou's electric guitar, cherry red, covered in stickers and scars. One string is a little rusty; that's on purpose. Clou hardly ever talks. But to her guitar, he does.
textes.La limonade maison de Sirène, au bar de: Sirène's homemade lemonade, from the bar at the Howling Hall: lemon, ginger, and a secret (very chatty bubbles). Alcohol-free. Restores one heart.
textes.La petite boule de buis de Raymond et Ma: Raymond and Marcel's little boxwood ball. Without it, there's no pétanque on the square.
textes.La petite lanterne de Lumina, la lantern: Lumina the lantern-maker's little lantern: a living ember flame that never goes out. With it, you light the seven Great Lanterns of Pandémonia.
textes.La pierre gravée qui animait un golem de: The carved stone that brought a highland golem to life. Bramm, the gate guard, asks for it as proof of your worth.
textes.La potion d'Aëlwen, l'herboriste du Bois: The potion of Aëlwen, the herbalist of Bois-Doré: golden sap and moon herbs. Restores three hearts.
textes.La première t'attend peut-être sous le v: The first one may be waiting for you under the village…
textes.La recette de Mamie Silex : des crosses: Granny Silex's recipe: crushed fern fiddleheads, toasted on a flat stone by the fire. Nice and crispy, a little smoky. Restores two hearts (and "extra squares", says Granny).
textes.La spécialité de Marée : des algues du d: Marée's speciality: seaweed from the dome, dried under the crystal and pressed. It tastes of the sea. A lot. Restores two hearts.
textes.La tarte de Berthe Chaudron, qui « ensor: Berthe Chaudron's pie, which "bewitches everyone". Melting, spiced, still warm. Restores three hearts.
textes.La tisane de Pivoine, à la sauge et à la: Pivoine's herbal tea, with sage and meadowsweet. They say it makes you sleep like a dormouse. Restores one heart.
textes.La télékinésie ne trouve rien à attraper: Telekinesis finds nothing to grab over there.
textes.La vieille boussole de marine de Barnabé: Barnabé's old ship's compass. It shows what you're really looking for. Usually, north.
textes.La vieille canne de Barnabé. Équipe-la,: Barnabé's old fishing rod. Equip it, go up to the water and hold the click to cast.
textes.Lait de coco, jus de mangue et une ombre: Coconut milk, mango juice and a paper umbrella. Toni's recipe (or Kiki's, depending on who you ask). Restores two hearts.
textes.Le Baron Barthélemy a perdu son plus bea: Baron Barthélemy has lost his finest hat, the plumed one: the wind carried it over the castle wall. It was seen flying over the rooftops of the Middle Town… then nothing more.
textes.Le Cœur de la Flèche, le grand cristal q: The Spire's Heart, the great crystal that keeps Astralys afloat, is growing weak: three shards have broken off and fallen onto the island. Volt, the energy engineer, can weld them back with three astral crystals, but then the Heart's light must be restored, right at the top of the Spire.
textes.Le Cœur-Brasier, le grand feu de la Cath: The Ember Heart, the great fire of the Forge Cathedral that warms all of Pandémonia, grows paler by the day. A chill is rising from the Nine Circles beneath the cathedral: they say the Frost Titan has carried off the Eternal Flame.
textes.Le Glisseur stellaire des Lumens (Ionie,: The Lumens' Star Glider (Ionie, at the Astralys Spaceport)
textes.Le Professeur Malachar propose de passer: Professor Malachar offers to let you sit the Infernal Academy exams: the trial of flames, the trial of the contract and the trial of sparks. The jury is strict, but fair (and a little singed).
textes.Le Vieux Silas jure que la carte du trés: Old Silas swears that Barbe-Sanglante's treasure map exists, torn into three pieces: one in the dungeon of the Cursed Fort, one in the mausoleum in the graveyard, and the third up the sleeve of Sylvain, the croupier. Philémon Lunette will know how to put it back together.
textes.Le bandeau doré entre les yeux ne trompe: The golden band between the eyes gives it away. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Le bleu de l'Étang Gommé: The blue of the Rubbed-Out Pond
textes.Le bol fumant du robot des nouilles du M: The steaming bowl from the noodle robot at the Night Market: noodles, a golden broth, an egg, vegetables, and a smiley face drawn in sauce. Restores two and a half hearts.
textes.Le bâton des sorciers d'Arcanelle, remis: The staff of the wizards of Arcanelle, presented at the Circle of Moonstones: wood from the Twisted Wood and a purple crystal. In hand, each spell costs one less point of magic. Damage: 6.
textes.Le cadeau de Lyra : son aiguille de cris: Lyra's gift: its crystal needle points towards the Mother Tree, to the east. With it, the boat can cross the mist of Bois-Doré.
textes.Le café du Café de la Bielle, passé sous: Coffee from the Crankshaft Café, pressure-brewed in a copper boiler. It would wake the dead, and it restores one heart.
textes.Le cerf-volant de Théo s'est envolé vers: Théo's kite has flown off towards the western hills.
textes.Le chef-d'œuvre d'Octave : acier trempé,: Octave's masterpiece: tempered steel, brass guard. Damage: 6, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard. Ready for the battles to come.
textes.Le chemin de Xibalba… on peut y descendr: The road to Xibalba… can we go down there?
textes.Le chocolat chaud du Café Feedback, avec: Hot chocolate from the Feedback Café, with a cloud of cream. It warms your hands, your tummy and your heart. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Le cidre doux du verger de Père Gaubert,: Père Gaubert's sweet sparkling apple drink from his orchard, alcohol-free and fizzy, served nice and cold at "La Grenouille Repue". The bubbles tickle your nose. Restores one heart.
textes.Le cœur du Roi Gélatineux : une grosse g: The heart of the Jelly King: a big green jelly that glows softly, with a tiny gold crown stuck on top. It still beats a little, like a happy pudding. Master Hugues has dreamed of it for twenty years.
textes.Le dernier coup d'un enchaînement frappe: The last blow of a combo hits twice as hard, and every blow has a one-in-eight chance to be critical.
textes.Le dire au capitaine Charbonnel (à la ca: Tell Captain Charbonnel (at the port's harbour master's office)
textes.Le dire au capitaine Pyrus (à la porte d: Tell Captain Pyrus (at the palace gate, or at the barracks)
textes.Le dire à Crochet (sur le quai le matin,: Tell Crochet (on the quay in the morning, at the forge in the afternoon, at the Shark's Tooth in the evening)
textes.Le dire à Cuauhtli, le grand prêtre (au: Tell Cuauhtli, the high priest (at the foot of the Great Temple)
textes.Le dire à Ix Kanul, la grande prêtresse: Tell Ix Kanul, the high priestess (at the temple, or at the Cenote in the morning)
textes.Le dire à Madame Hurla (au guichet de l': Tell Madame Hurla (at the arena ticket booth, or on the square)
textes.Le dire à Mixtli, le guerrier-jaguar (su: Tell Mixtli, the jaguar warrior (on the square of Aztlán)
textes.Le dire à Néferet, la prêtresse de Rê (a: Tell Néferet, the priestess of Ra (at the temple of Per-Hâpy)
textes.Le dire à Pigment (au Mur d'Expression l: Tell Pigment (at the Expression Wall in the morning, near the water tower or the skatepark in the afternoon, at the print shop in the evening)
textes.Le dire à Tom le Violoneux (au Crâne Fen: Tell Tom the Fiddler (at the Crâne Fendu, in the evening)
textes.Le dire à Yvon (sur son ponton de pêche,: Tell Yvon (on his fishing jetty, by the lake)
textes.Le dire à Zébuline (à son étal d'épices: Tell Zébuline (at her spice stall in the Great Market)
textes.Le dire à l'Archiduchesse Ignatia (au pa: Tell Archduchess Ignatia (at the palace, on the Citadel)
textes.Le fanzine de Port-Boucan, imprimé par A: Port-Boucan's fanzine, printed by Agrafe at the Spinning Mill print shop: drawings by Pigment, Lentille's soup recipe, gossip from Radio Boucan, and a whole page about this week's stand-in drummer.
textes.Le flacon brun du Doc Saignée : rhum, mi: Doc Saignée's brown flask: molasses, honey, feverweed and a secret. One sip, and you get back up from almost any brawl. Restores four hearts.
textes.Le fromage des chèvres des cendres de Hi: Cheese from Hilda's ash goats. It smells strong. Restores two hearts.
textes.Le jaune de la Grève Blanche: The yellow of the White Strand
textes.Le journal du dernier capitaine du Lévia: The journal of the last captain of the Léviathan, bound in leather that still smells of salt. Whole pages are blank… Moon ink, Ba Sidi used to say: it can only be read by the light of a moon you carry with you.
textes.Le maire fera citoyen d'honneur celui qu: The mayor will make whoever helps out the whole town an honorary citizen.
textes.Le maire veut que je fasse connaissance: The mayor wants me to get to know the town: the harbour master's office, the hotel and the tavern.
textes.Le masque des Rois-Ciel, trouvé dans le: The mask of the Sky Kings, found in Lord Storm's treasure: crystal lenses rimmed with brass. As long as it's in your bag, you can breathe underwater. The Sky Kings used it to visit… a sunken city?
textes.Le nectar doré de Mélisse, cueilli au cœ: Mélisse's golden nectar, gathered from the heart of the giant flowers. Restores four hearts.
textes.Le noyau encore chaud d'un élémentaire d: The still-warm core of a magma elemental. Grimli the miner uses them to light his tunnels.
textes.Le pain de Trèfle, la boulangère de Ramu: Bread from Trèfle, the baker of Ramure: soft, golden, made with carrots from the rabbits' vegetable garden. Restores two hearts.
textes.Le pain doré de Sylwen, la boulangère du: The golden bread of Sylwen, the baker of Bois-Doré. It smells of honey and sunshine. Restores two hearts.
textes.Le panier de livraison de Margaux, rempl: Margaux's delivery basket, full of baguettes and croissants. No helping yourself.
textes.Le pinceau des doyens du Village des Arb: The brush of the elders of the Treehouse Village, entrusted to you by Grandma Aquarelle. It only paints with the colours of the Stone Palette: dip it in the Palette (20 strokes), then, in hand, E (trigger in VR) to put a dab of colour in front of you, on Sketched Island.
textes.Le professeur Boum a encore perdu le toi: Professor Boum has lost the roof of his workshop again. For the fifteenth one, he needs iron ore.
textes.Le professeur Moreau rêve de la cité eng: Professor Moreau dreams of the sunken city. Someone needs to find it, rekindle its crystal, and tell him all about it.
textes.Le ragoût de Mama Grog : poisson, banane: Mama Grog's stew: fish, plantains, red beans, chilli and a ladle of molasses. Nobody asks what else is in it. Restores three hearts.
textes.Le rat du Requin Borgne: The rat of the Requin Borgne
textes.Le rhum brun du Crâne Fendu, vieilli dan: The brown tonic of Le Crâne Fendu, aged in barrels from a sunken ship. It smells of wood, molasses and a little of gunpowder. Restores one heart.
textes.Le rhum noir de La Murène Ivre. Les pira: The dark tonic of La Murène Ivre. Pirates say it warms the heart; Anouk would say otherwise. Restores one heart.
textes.Le soir (à partir de 21 h), retrouver Gé: In the evening (from 9 p.m.), meet Gédéon at the entrance to the Howling Hall and walk him to the drum kit: let him play his first concert with the Bilge Rats
textes.Le tajine de Lalla Zohra : dorade, olive: Lalla Zohra's tagine: sea bream, olives, preserved lemon and saffron, cooked for three hours over the embers. Restores four hearts.
textes.Le trident des rois de l'Atlantide, offe: The trident of the kings of Atlantis, a gift from Queen Néréa. Gold, mother-of-pearl and a glowing sea stone. Damage: 14, and the third hit of a combo strikes half again as hard. Underwater, it strikes from afar.
textes.Le trophée du Tournoi des Cornes : une c: The trophy of the Tournament of Horns: a ram's horn of solid gold, engraved with the names of all the champions. Yours is at the very bottom, in letters that still shine.
textes.Le trésor de Barbe-Sanglante… raconte-mo: Barbe-Sanglante's treasure… tell me about it.
textes.Le vent a dispersé les trois pages de la: The wind has scattered the three pages of Django's most beautiful song across the quay, the square and the beach.
textes.Le vert du Bois des Hachures: The green of the Hatching Wood
textes.Le vieil appareil photo de Gérard Dupuis: Gérard Dupuis's old camera. Three hundred photos of sunsets inside.
textes.Les coups qui enlèvent un cœur ou plus p: Blows that take a heart or more lose half a heart.
textes.Les crocodiles de l'embouchure de l'Iter: The crocodiles at the mouth of the Iterou keep stealing the nets of Khéty, the fisherman. He wants someone to bring him two of their teeth, so they get the message.
textes.Les fusées de Zigomar prêtes, revenir la: With Zigomar's rockets ready, come back at night (after 8 p.m.) to the Great Lantern Square for the party
textes.Les graines lumineuses de Photon se sont: Photon's glowing seeds have flown off to the Zero-Gravity Garden: over there nothing falls back down, and they're floating right at the top. Photon's knees are too old to jump that high. They must be caught (three seeds) and brought back to him so you can plant them together.
textes.Les jaguars du Mont Fumant: The jaguars of the Smoking Mountain
textes.Les jaguars du volcan… je viens avec toi: The volcano jaguars… I'm coming with you.
textes.Les navires ont un problème, capitaine ?: Are the ships in trouble, captain?
textes.Les paniers de légumes des Jardins Parta: The vegetable baskets from the Shared Gardens haven't arrived at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen. No vegetables, no soup, and no soup means half of the Boucan will go hungry tonight. Three baskets must be fetched from the Shared Gardens.
textes.Les perles pour ta robe de fête: The pearls for your party dress
textes.Les perles pour ta robe de fête…: The pearls for your party dress…
textes.Les pouvoirs des sceaux se rechargent 30: Seal powers recharge 30% faster. (You need at least one seal.)
textes.Les robots déménageurs de Monsieur Lisse: Mr Lisse's mover robots stole the Bilge Rats' gear just before the Great Boucan, the biggest concert of the year: Germaine the Terrible (Clou's guitar), the tube amp and the drumsticks. You need to find everything, give the guitar and the amp back to Rouille, then come to the Great Boucan, in the evening, at the Howling Hall.
textes.Les trois fragments de jade, soudés auto: The three jade fragments, joined around a green eye. Underground, it lights up the darkness around you. It hums near the seal of the Abyss.
textes.Les trois morceaux recousus au fil de so: The three pieces sewn back together with silk thread by Philémon Lunette: One-Eye Peak, the Balafre, and at the end of the ravine a skull marked with a red cross. In the margin, in shaky handwriting: "My first mate keeps watch."
textes.Lever les yeux vers le Grand Spaghetti V: Look up at the Great Flying Spaghetti
textes.Lili Pinceau, la fille de Basile (neuf a: Lili Pinceau, Basile's daughter (nine and a half), saw the pot of yellow (no. 4) roll along the beach to the big sandcastle at the far end of the shore, to the west. But the tide has covered everything, and she can't remember where the castle door is.
textes.Lire les pages blanches du journal de bo: Read the blank pages of the logbook by Moonglow (key 4 then X; in VR, B), with the logbook in your bag
textes.Livrer le pain à Edmond (Grand Hôtel): Deliver the bread to Edmond (Grand Hotel)
textes.Livrer le pain à Gisèle (Café de la Plac: Deliver the bread to Gisèle (the Square Café)
textes.Livrer le pain à Paulo (Chez Paulo, sur: Deliver the bread to Paulo (Chez Paulo, on the quay)
textes.Lord Pemberton paierait cher une vraie c: Lord Pemberton would pay a lot for a real curiosity: a feather from the giant eagle, a naga scale, or a shark tooth.
textes.Lourde et bien équilibrée. Elle abat les: Heavy and well balanced. It fells young trees (a pale notch on the trunk) and coconut palms: logs, coconuts, honey… Damage: 5.
textes.Lumina, la lanternière, prépare la Nuit: Lumina, the lantern-maker, is preparing the Night of Lanterns: the seven Great Lanterns of the city must be lit. When they're all shining, and Zigomar's rockets are ready, Pandémonia will dance all night long on the Great Square.
textes.Lève ta garde (F, ou grip gauche en VR): Raise your guard (F, or left grip in VR) at the last moment, just before the blow: no damage, the enemy is stunned and your riposte hits double.
textes.Légendaire. Barnabé dit qu'il n'en exist: Legendary. Barnabé says there is only one. He was wrong.
textes.Madame Hurla, la maîtresse de l'Arène de: Madame Hurla, mistress of the Arena of Horns, is looking for a contender for the great tournament: four rounds, the last one against Gorgoth the Horned, the undefeated champion.
textes.Madame Olga a ouvert sa fenêtre pour fai: Madame Olga opened her window to let out a draught spell. The spell got out, along with three pages of her spellbook. They've been scattered all over town.
textes.Madame Olga, votre grimoire a l'air bien: Madame Olga, your spellbook looks rather thin
Madame Olga, your spellbook looks rather thin…
textes.Mamie Tournesol et Mère Averse ont fait: Granny Sunflower and Mother Downpour have made peace: the Larsen Festival can come back! Jack, the head roadie, has been repairing the Main Stage for years. He's missing Galet's ropes, Lune's canvas… and someone to tell Mégaphone to finally press his third button.
textes.Mamie Tournesol, la doyenne du Camp des: Granny Sunflower, the eldest of the Flower Camp, and Mother Downpour, the eldest of Rainville, were the best friends in the world. Fifty years ago, they fell out over the weather (sun or rain for the festival?), and since then nobody has dared to step onto the Main Stage. Granny Sunflower would like to make peace… but she doesn't dare.
textes.Mamie Tournesol, pourquoi regardez-vous: Granny Sunflower, why are you looking at Rainville like that?
textes.Mamie, comment arrêter Lisse pour de bon: Mamie, how do we stop Lisse for good?
textes.Mamie, que se passe-t-il quand la sirène: Mamie, what happens when the siren wails?
textes.Manette : croix ou stick pour viser: Controller: d-pad or stick to aim
textes.Margaux n'a personne pour livrer le pain: Margaux has no one to deliver the bread to Chez Paulo, the Square Café and the Grand Hotel.
textes.Matthias rêve d'ouvrir la Porte aux Quat: Matthias dreams of opening the Gate of the Four Seals. The four seals must be found, one for each people of the great island: the sea spray of Carène, the sands of Tazira, the bronze of the northern shepherds, the mists of Ramure. Each seal leads to the next.
textes.Matthias, le cartographe de Carène, rêve: Matthias, the mapmaker of Carène, dreams of drawing the heart of the island. He'd like to know what the great sealed gate at the foot of Stoneheart looks like.
textes.Maître Hugues, la fontaine fait des bull: Master Hugues, the fountain is making green bubbles
Master Hugues, the fountain is making green bubbles…
textes.Mener la lumière de la sève jusqu'au cœu: Guide the light of the sap to the heartwood
textes.Messager du Soleil et de la Pluie: Messenger of the Sun and the Rain
textes.Mettre au tapis les trois champions du p: Knock down the three harbour champions, with fists and no blades: Gros-Louis (Requin Borgne), the Silent One (Veuve Écarlate), Belle-Humeur (Morue Enragée) — you can offer them a fair duel
textes.Mio, pourquoi Zéro ne fait-il que « bip: Mio, why does Zéro only ever say "beep"?
textes.Miou, le chat roux à l'oreille tordue de: Miou, little Nebet's ginger cat with the crooked ear, has been missing for three days. Khéty says cats love the coolness of the tombs, up on the plateau of Ra.
textes.Mode PC classique — F11 plein écran • F6: Classic PC mode — F11 full screen • F6 ultra sharpness (GPU) • no headset needed.
textes.Monsieur Fil, le marchand de programmes: Mr Fil, the program seller of the Alleys, sold you his "Turbo-Adventure 3000" for a few coins. He copied it into your travel journal… and it was a virus! A fake one, luckily: it's part of the game. Glitch, the Arcade District hacker, is helping you get rid of it.
textes.Monsieur Prosper, le marchand de maisons: Mr Prosper, the house seller of the Upper Town, is selling the Wisteria Cottage: a bed, a fireplace, a trophy shelf and a front covered in wisteria. Three hundred coins. He exaggerates everything. Except the wisteria.
textes.Monsieur le Baron, vous êtes tout décoif: Baron, your hair is all over the place!
textes.Monter au sommet de la Flèche de Cristal: Fly to the top of the Crystal Spire (with the Star Glider) and give the Heart back its shards and its light
textes.Monter au sommet de la Tour Penchée en l: Levitate up to the top of the Leaning Tower (key 8 then V; in VR, left trigger) and ring the bell (E)
textes.Monter au sommet du Mont Fusain: Climb to the summit of Mount Charcoal
textes.Monter au sommet du Mont Fusain (le chem: Climb to the summit of Mount Charcoal (the path starts at the north exit of the clearing) and take the pot of purple at the foot of the cairn
textes.Monter dans le Village des Arbres-Maison: Climb up into the Treehouse Village
textes.Monter en haut de la Cascade d'Encre (pa: Climb to the top of the Ink Waterfall (by the Mount Charcoal path, then along the stream) and take the pot of orange by the water, on the Lip
textes.Monter jusqu'à la Marmite, en haut du Mo: Climb up to the Cooking Pot, at the top of Mount Bolognese
textes.Monter sur Astralys par le rayon d'accue: Go up to Astralys on the welcome beam (the glowing buoy, in the north-west of the archipelago)
textes.Monter vers le centre de l'île (à l'est: Go up towards the centre of the island (east of Carène) and examine the great gate at the foot of Stoneheart
textes.Monter voir Bucatini, le gardien de la M: Go up to see Bucatini, the keeper of the Cooking Pot, at the very top of Mount Bolognese (by the spiral path, in the daytime)
textes.Monter à la Terrasse du Ciel, en haut de: Go up to the Sky Terrace, at the top of the Axiom Tower
textes.Montrer la fresque du tombeau à Céleste: Show the tomb's fresco to Céleste Lunette, the astronomer of Cliquetis (at her observatory)
textes.Montrer le pot d'orange à Achille (au pi: Show the pot of orange to Achille (at the foot of the waterfall in the daytime, near the Palette in the evening), then pour it into the Palette
textes.Montrer le pot de bleu à Basile (au bord: Show the pot of blue to Basile (by the pond in the daytime, on the Brush Oak terrace at noon), then pour it into the Palette
textes.Montrer le pot de jaune à Lili (sur la p: Show the pot of yellow to Lili (on the beach in the daytime, at the swing in the evening), then pour it into the Palette
textes.Montrer le pot de rouge à Capucine (aux: Show the pot of red to Capucine (in the White Meadows in the daytime, on the Blotter Oak terrace at noon and in the evening), then pour it into the Palette
textes.Montrer le pot de vert à Rosalie (à la l: Show the pot of green to Rosalie (at the edge of the wood in the daytime, on the Eraser Oak terrace at noon), then pour it into the Palette
textes.Montrer le pot de violet à Gaspard (au B: Show the pot of purple to Gaspard (at the Lookout in the daytime), then pour it into the Palette
textes.Montrer les cinq champignons à Mère Mori: Show the five mushrooms to Mère Morille (at her caravan, in the middle of the Spore Cathedral)
textes.Montrer les trois sceaux à la Dame de Pr: Show the three seals to the Lady of the Prow, the Léviathan's figurehead (right at the front of the deck, near the telescope)
textes.Montrer les étoiles de mer à Kevin, au p: Show the starfish to Kevin, at the lifeguard post
textes.Mère Brasille, la jardinière des Jardins: Mère Brasille, the gardener of the Ash Gardens, would like five ember flowers for her flowerbeds. They only grow on the slopes of the Great Blaze.
textes.Mère Morille, la sage de la Cathédrale d: Mother Morille, the wise woman of the Spore Cathedral, wants to teach you about the five fairy mushrooms that grow in the old gasholder: the Spring-Bolete, the Moonling, the Chatterbox, the Rainbow and the Little-Giant. They must be picked and shown to her. These are storybook mushrooms: in real life, you never eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Mère Morille, quels sont ces champignons: Mère Morille, what are these glowing mushrooms?
textes.Mère Sauge m'apprendra le sort de soin s: Mère Sauge will teach me the healing spell if I bring her three mushrooms from the Twisted Wood. Then I'll have to heal the injured owl that lives near Agathe's caravan.
textes.Mère-Lune, la doyenne de Ramure, change: Mère-Lune, the eldest of Ramure, changes the moon lanterns on the bridges every spring. Her old paws can no longer reach the edge of the ponds, where the glowing mushrooms grow.
textes.Nadine voudrait que des cartes postales: Nadine would like postcards from Port-Azur to reach the four corners of the archipelago.
textes.Nager jusqu'au nénuphar géant, au milieu: Swim to the giant water lily in the middle of the Rubbed-Out Pond and take the pot of blue
textes.Nova, vous cherchez quelque chose ?: Nova, are you looking for something?
textes.Néopolis, au sud de l'archipel: Neopolis, in the south of the archipelago
textes.Néopolis, la ville qui ne dort jamais: Neopolis, the city that never sleeps
textes.Obtenir la bourse de Jambe-de-Bois (paye: Get Jambe-de-Bois's purse (pay off his debt, or beat him in a fair duel), then bring it to Mama Grog, at the Crâne Fendu
textes.Odette doit tenir le registre des bateau: Odette has to keep the register of boats. She's missing the names of Fernand's, Yannick's and Lucas's boats.
textes.On peut passer les examens de l'Académie: Can we take the Academy exams?
textes.OpenXR absent. Relance en activant Meta: OpenXR missing. Restart with Meta Quest Link or SteamVR turned on.
textes.OpenXR non connecté. Entre d'abord dans: OpenXR not connected. First enter Quest Link on the headset, then press R.
textes.Orbe, cette grande vitrine est presque v: Orbe, this big display case is almost empty
Orbe, this big display case is almost empty…
textes.Orbe, l'Archiviste du Musée des Mondes,: Orbe, the Archivist of the Museum of Worlds, wants to complete the great display case of the islands down below: a seashell from the sea of Port-Azur, a parrot feather from Balafre, a scarab from the Island of the Three Suns, a Bilge Rats patch from Boucan Island and a golden turnip from Montjoie.
textes.Ouvrir la Grande Porte de Forgefer: Open the Great Gate of Forgefer
textes.Ouvrir la Porte aux Quatre Sceaux: Open the Gate of the Four Seals
textes.Ouvrir la porte des Neuf Cercles: Open the gate of the Nine Circles
textes.Ouvrir le Temple de Kukulkan à la date d: Open the Temple of Kukulkan on the date of creation
textes.Ouvrir le coffre du premier fragment d'a: Open the chest with the first amulet fragment
textes.PC : 1 à 4 pour choisir un pouvoir, X po: PC: 1 to 4 to choose a power, X to cast it. VR: B to cast, hold B to switch.
textes.PC : 5 à 0 pour choisir un sort, V pour: PC: 5 to 0 to choose a spell, V to cast it, B for the next one. VR: left trigger to cast, hold it to switch.
textes.Parler à Germaine, la femme de Père Gaub: Talk to Germaine, Père Gaubert's wife (at the farm, in the yard in the morning and late afternoon, in the fields late in the morning, at the market in the afternoon)
textes.Parler à Gédéon après le concert (à la H: Talk to Gédéon after the concert (at the Howling Hall, or the next day in town)
textes.Parler à Hector, l'armurier (rue du Phar: Talk to Hector, the armourer (Lighthouse Street)
textes.Parler à Jack après le concert (près de: Talk to Jack after the concert (near the stage, or the next day)
textes.Parler à Mange-Clous, le cuisinier du Re: Talk to Mange-Clous, the cook of the Requin Borgne (on the deck of the Requin Borgne in the morning, by the fireplace of the Crâne Fendu around noon, at the nets on the quay in the afternoon)
textes.Parler à Pauline, la femme de chambre (a: Talk to Pauline, the chambermaid (at the Grand Hotel: in the corridors in the morning and afternoon, in the hotel garden at noon)
textes.Parler à Rouille après le concert (à la: Talk to Rouille after the concert (at the Howling Hall, or the next day at the Cannery)
Tell me about the Wisteria Cottage.
textes.Passer au Borgo des Coquillettes, le ham: Stop by the Borgo of the Macaroni, the followers' hamlet
textes.Passer l'épreuve du contrat avec Ombreli: Take the contract test with Ombreline, the librarian (at the Library of Souls)
textes.Paulo veut des poissons pêchés du jour :: Paulo wants fish caught today: two sea bream and two mackerel.
textes.Payer dix pièces à Églantine et poser la: Pay Églantine ten coins and lay your hand on the crystal ball (at the Adventurers' Guild counter, on the Great Square in the Middle Town)
textes.Payer trois cents pièces à Monsieur Pros: Pay three hundred coins to Mr Prosper (at his agency in the Upper Town, or in the garden of the Wisteria Cottage at noon)
textes.Peindre trois graffitis avec les bombes: Paint three graffiti with the spray paint cans (on the Expression Wall, west of the town, or on another paintable wall in Port-Boucan)
textes.Pendant la dernière tempête, l'antenne d: During the last storm, the Radio Boucan antenna blew off the mast of the Rusty Whale and landed on top of the painted water tower. Without it, Sergeant Fréquence is talking to nobody.
textes.Pendant la roulade (Ctrl), les coups pas: During the roll (Ctrl), blows pass right through you. It goes further and costs less stamina. In VR: click the left stick to dodge.
textes.Pendant une Grande Alerte des Navets (qu: During a Great Turnip Alert (when Mélusine rings her bell, in the daytime), run to the Southern Fields (south of town, through the South Gate), catch five runaway turnips with a little tap, then bring them to Père Gaubert (in his fields, near the farm)
textes.Pense très fort à un lieu que tu as déjà: Think hard about a place you have already seen… and you'll be there. Choose your destination:
textes.Personne ici… pour l'instant. Allez salu: Nobody here… for now. Go and say hello to the locals!
textes.Petit poisson argenté des côtes. Rend un: A small silvery fish from the coast. Restores half a heart.
textes.Petit-Pierre, pourquoi tu caches du pain: Petit-Pierre, why are you hiding bread in your pocket?
textes.Petites baies sucrées des buissons. Rend: Small sweet berries from the bushes. Restores half a heart.
textes.Photon, vos plantes clignotent bizarreme: Photon, your plants are blinking strangely
Photon, your plants are blinking strangely…
textes.Pigment, la graffeuse, trouve que tu as: Pigment, the graffiti artist, thinks you "look like someone who makes beautiful walls". She gives you three spray paint cans: three graffiti must be painted on the paintable walls of Port-Boucan.
textes.Pixel et son petit frère Quark jouent à: Pixel and her little brother Quark are playing hide-and-seek, and Quark always cheats. Pixel invites the hero to play: the two children will hide somewhere in Astralys, and both of them must be found.
textes.Pixel, tu veux jouer à quelque chose ?: Pixel, do you want to play something?
textes.Plonger au pied de la pointe du phare, c: Dive at the foot of the lighthouse point, on the open-sea side, and find the lens shard
textes.Plume-de-Nuage, la plus jeune méduse de: Cloudfeather, Nova's youngest sky jellyfish, has escaped from the Greenhouse of Species. She's floating somewhere around the island and can't find her way home on her own. Sextant, who draws the island from the lookouts, may have seen her go by.
textes.Porter le bouquet à Mère Averse, à Rainv: Take the bouquet to Mother Downpour, in Rainville (in the daytime, in the street or on the terrace of the Feedback Café)
textes.Porter le rouage à Hortense, devant la m: Take the cogwheel to Hortense, in front of the town hall
textes.Porter un pain à Aurore (au château, au: Take a loaf of bread to Aurore (at the castle, at the top of the Hill: take the winding ramps all the way up)
textes.Porter un pain à Gilles (le garde de la: Take a loaf of bread to Gilles (the North Gate guard, in the Lower Town, near the harbour)
textes.Porter un pain à Mamie Rissole (à la tav: Take a loaf of bread to Mamie Rissole (at the tavern, at the back of the Adventurers' Guild)
textes.Porter une affiche à Paulo (à Port-Azur,: Take a poster to Paulo (in Port-Azur, at his restaurant Chez Paulo, on the harbour, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. and from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m.)
textes.Porter une affiche à Tom le Violoneux (s: Take a poster to Tom the Fiddler (on Balafre Island, in Port-Coutelas: he plays in the evening on the stage of the Crâne Fendu, and in the afternoon you can find him on the square)
textes.Porter une affiche à Ulric (sur l'Île de: Take a poster to Ulric (on Montjoie Island, at his inn "La Grenouille Repue", in the Middle Town, near the Great Square)
textes.Porter une carte postale à Barnabé (île: Take a postcard to Barnabé (Jungle Island)
textes.Porter une carte postale à Lyra, l'elfe: Take a postcard to Lyra the elf
textes.Porter une carte postale à Ulfa, à la ta: Take a postcard to Ulfa, at the Forgefer tavern
textes.Porter une carte postale à la reine de l: Take a postcard to the queen of Atlantis
textes.Porter une lettre à Gorgoth le Cornu (à: Take a letter to Gorgoth the Horned (at the arena, or at the baths)
textes.Porter une lettre à Grumbald (au comptoi: Take a letter to Grumbald (at the counter of the inn "Au Diable Repu", at the port)
textes.Porter une lettre à Ombreline (à la Bibl: Take a letter to Ombreline (at the Library of Souls, in the Upper Town)
textes.Poser le Plat de la Grande Réconciliatio: Place the Great Reconciliation dish on the altar of the Colander Temple
textes.Poser le fromage près de la cale du Requ: Put the cheese down near the hold of the Requin Borgne and wait for Biscotte to come out of his hole: if he climbs onto your shoulder, you've won
textes.Poser les quatre sceaux dans la Porte au: Place the four seals in the Gate of the Four Seals, at the foot of Stoneheart
textes.Poser les trois reliques sur l'Autel des: Place the three relics on the Altar of the Three Suns
textes.Pour accepter des contrats, recruter des: To take on contracts, recruit companions and rise in rank, you must be signed up with the Adventurers' Guild of Montjoie. Églantine, the receptionist, asks for ten coins and a little crystal-ball reading.
textes.Prendre en holo-photo Aristide, le maire: Take a holo-photo of Aristide, the mayor of Port-Azur (at the town hall, on the square; at noon at Paulo's, in the late afternoon at the boules pitch)
textes.Prendre en holo-photo Mama Grog (Île de: Take a holo-photo of Mama Grog (Balafre Island, in Port-Coutelas: at the counter of the Crâne Fendu, from 10 a.m. until late at night)
textes.Prendre en holo-photo Mamie Barricade (Î: Take a holo-photo of Mamie Barricade (Boucan Island, in Port-Boucan: at the Cannery, in the assembly room on the roof, or in front of the entrance in the afternoon)
textes.Prendre en holo-photo le Baron Barthélem: Take a holo-photo of Baron Barthélemy (Montjoie Island, at the castle, at the top of the Hill: throne room in the morning, garden or rampart in the afternoon)
textes.Prendre la grande toile de Lune, roulée: Take Lune's big canvas, rolled up next to her loom (in the Flower Camp, near the northern yurts)
textes.Prendre la puce vocale Série Z, contre l: Take the Z-Series voice chip, against the orange container (the first one west of the pier)
textes.Prendre la puce vocale dans la petite bo: Take the voice chip from the little black box, against the orange container (the first one west of the pier)
textes.Prendre le parapluie aux tournesols, sur: Take the sunflower umbrella from the porch of Mother Downpour's yurt (Rainville, at the top of the main street, on the left)
textes.Prendre le rouleau de cordes que Galet a: Take the roll of ropes Galet has prepared for the stage (at the Ropeworks, in the north-west, next to the spinning wheel)
textes.Puis-je aider le jury de la Foire ?: Can I help the Fair's judges?
textes.Pyra Flammèche m'apprendra la boule de f: Pyra Flammèche will teach me the fireball if I bring her three logs of twisted wood. Then I'll have to light the five braziers of the Duelling Ground in a row.
textes.Père Gaubert, qu'est-ce qui a creusé ce: Père Gaubert, what dug this hole in your field?
textes.Pépin, le lapin qui organise la Grande C: Pépin, the rabbit who organises Ramure's Great Race, is looking for someone who can beat Bondi, the champion three years running.
textes.Pépin, le petit diablotin de Zébuline, n: Pépin, Zébuline's little imp, hasn't come home from the Academy. His classmates saw him heading off to the Ash Wood to see the glowing mushrooms.
textes.Pêcher et apporter à Paulo deux dorades: Catch two sea bream and two mackerel and bring them to Paulo
textes.Qu'est-ce que ce chat vous a volé ?: What did that cat steal from you?
textes.Quand j'aurai appris les six sorts des m: When I've learnt the six spells of the masters of Arcanelle, the archmage will lead me to the Moonstone Circle for the ceremony.
textes.Quand la sirène sonne et que Sergent Fré: When the siren wails and Sergeant Fréquence sounds the alarm on the radio (in the daytime, in town), fight off the Movers' Raid: stop the robots before they carry the furniture off to the harbour
textes.Que cherchez-vous sur cette carte ?: What are you looking for on that map?
textes.Que cherchez-vous, milord ?: What are you looking for, milord?
textes.Que faut-il faire, au sommet du Grand Te: What must be done at the top of the Great Temple?
textes.Que puis-je faire pour Port-Azur ?: What can I do for Port-Azur?
textes.Que se passe-t-il, avec l'horloge ?: What's going on with the clock?
textes.Que sont ces lanternes bleues, sur les p: What are those blue lanterns on the bridges?
textes.Quelqu'un vole les croissants de Margaux: Someone steals Margaux's croissants every night. Officer Lefort wants witness statements.
textes.Raconter la fresque de la Bergerie à Mèr: Tell Mother Moon, the elder of Ramure, about the Sheepfold fresco
textes.Raconter tout au Vieux Silas (près des f: Tell Old Silas everything (near the fires on the shore in the morning, at the Crâne Fendu in the evening)
textes.Raconter à Matthias ce que j'ai vu (capi: Tell Matthias what I saw (Carène harbour master's office, on the poop deck)
textes.Raconter à Nadine le voyage de ses carte: Tell Nadine about her postcards' journey
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile de la Lune: Rekindle the crystal of the Moon Wing (to the east)
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile des Marées: Rekindle the crystal of the Tide Wing (to the west)
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile des Rouage: Rekindle the crystal of the Cog Wing (to the north)
textes.Rallumer le cristal de l'Aile des Sables: Rekindle the crystal of the Sand Wing (to the south)
textes.Ramasser les trois éclats de lune : près: Pick up the three moon shards: near the altar of the Circle of Moonstones (west of the Academy), in the Twisted Wood (to the south-west) and on the western shore
textes.Ramasser trois bûches de bois tordu dans: Pick up three logs of twisted wood in the Twisted Wood (south-west of the island)
textes.Ramasser trois cristaux de soufre au bor: Pick up three sulphur crystals at the edge of the hot springs (at the foot of the Great Blaze)
textes.Ramasser trois flocons de givre éternel: Pick up three everlasting frost flakes on the northern cliffs of the island
textes.Ramasser trois fragments de météorite to: Gather three meteorite fragments that fell during the last shooting-star shower (one on the Agora of Stars, one in the Hanging Gardens, one at the Spaceport)
textes.Ramasser trois paniers de légumes dans l: Gather three baskets of vegetables in the Shared Gardens (east of the town, near the container village of the Boxes)
textes.Ramasser trois plumes du vent : sur la c: Pick up three wind feathers: on the western hill, at the edge of the northern cliffs, and on the eastern cliff
Pick up items on the island with E.
textes.Ramener Miou à Nebet, à Per-Hâpy: Bring Miou back to Nebet, in Per-Hâpy
