textes.Ramener Rhubarbe à la capitaine Anne-Ros: Bring Rhubarbe back to Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau (at the helm of the Requin Borgne by day; at the Crâne Fendu at noon)
textes.Ramener Sardine à Tornade (au Bassin à s: Bring Sardine back to Tornade (at the Dry Dock, the skatepark, in the north-east of the town)
textes.Rapporter 4 bûches à Tobias (une hache e: Bring 4 logs to Tobias (an axe and a tree will do), on the Léviathan's lower deck
textes.Rapporter au Révérend Père Farfalle (au: Bring Reverend Father Farfalle (at the Colander Temple) Mamma Lasagna's pasta, a jar of volcano sauce and the Golden Grater
textes.Rapporter deux dents de crocodile à Khét: Bring two crocodile teeth to Khéty (the crocodiles lie at the mouth of the Iterou, east of Per-Hâpy)
textes.Rapporter l'alliance à Léa: Bring the wedding ring back to Léa
textes.Rapporter l'antenne à Sergent Fréquence: Bring the antenna back to Sergeant Fréquence (at the Radio Boucan studio, in the wheelhouse of the stranded cargo ship in the north-west)
textes.Rapporter l'engrenage à Firmin Cogne, à: Bring the gear back to Firmin Cogne, at his stand at the Fair
textes.Rapporter l'holo-photo à Glorb (il se pr: Bring the holo-photo back to Glorb (he wanders all over Astralys: Museum, Agora, Nebula Café, lookouts, Bazaar…)
textes.Rapporter l'éclat de lentille à Anselme,: Bring the lens shard back to Anselme, at the lighthouse
textes.Rapporter l'Œil d'Horus de la Pyramide d: Bring back the Eye of Horus from the Pyramid of Ra
textes.Rapporter la Plume de Quetzalcóatl des C: Bring back Quetzalcóatl's Feather from the Five Suns
textes.Rapporter la bannière à Sire Tancrède (à: Bring the banner back to Sir Tancrède (at the Guild, in the castle courtyard in the morning, or on the ramparts in the afternoon)
textes.Rapporter la carte au Capitaine Croc-de-: Bring the map back to Captain Croc-de-Sel (on the deck of the Murène Noire by day, at La Murène Ivre in the evening)
textes.Rapporter la clochette d'argent à Bedain: Bring the silver bell back to Bedaine, at the Swap Market (at the foot of the Mother Oak)
textes.Rapporter la graine à la reine Oriane, d: Bring the seed back to Queen Oriane, in the fairy clearing
textes.Rapporter la partition à Django: Bring the sheet music back to Django
textes.Rapporter la puce à Kenji, à son atelier: Bring the chip back to Kenji, at his workshop in the Alleys
textes.Rapporter le Cœur de gelée royale à Maît: Bring the Royal jelly heart back to Master Hugues (in his office, at the back of the Guild, or at a tavern table in the evening)
textes.Rapporter le Masque de Jade de Xibalba: Bring back the Jade Mask from Xibalba
textes.Rapporter le chapeau au Baron Barthélemy: Bring the hat back to Baron Barthélemy (at the castle, at the top of the Hill: throne room in the morning, garden or rampart in the afternoon)
textes.Rapporter le panier vide à Margaux: Bring the empty basket back to Margaux
textes.Rapporter le parapluie à Mamie Tournesol: Bring the umbrella back to Granny Sunflower, in the Flower Camp
textes.Rapporter les champignons à Mère-Lune (d: Bring the mushrooms back to Mother Moon (in front of her house, halfway up the Mother Oak, or at the Moon Circle at night)
textes.Rapporter les noms à Odette, à la capita: Bring the names back to Odette at the harbour master's office
textes.Rapporter les plans du Lisse-Center à Ma: Bring the Lisse-Center plans back to Mamie Barricade (at the Cannery, in the assembly room on the roof)
textes.Rapporter les quatre livres à Théophrast: Bring the four books back to Théophraste Filandre
textes.Rapporter les trois graines à Photon et: Bring the three seeds back to Photon and plant them with him (in the Hanging Gardens, west of the Agora)
textes.Rapporter les trois pages à Madame Olga: Bring the three pages back to Madame Olga (at her magic shop, on the Great Square)
textes.Rapporter trois dents de crocodile à Bru: Bring three crocodile teeth to Brutus, at the forge (you get them from the crocodiles of the Drowned Marsh, west of the island)
textes.Rapporter à Orbe un coquillage (sur les: Bring Orbe a seashell (from the beaches of Port-Azur or Village Island), a parrot feather (Balafre Island), a scarab (Island of the Three Suns), a Bilge Rats patch (Boucan Island) and a golden turnip (Montjoie Island, in the Southern Fields) — Orbe is at the Museum of Worlds, west of the Agora
textes.Rattraper trois graines lumineuses qui f: Catch three glowing seeds floating high up in the Zero-Gravity Garden (at the end of the bridge of light, past the Hanging Gardens: you jump three times higher there)
textes.Raymond et Marcel ont perdu leur cochonn: Raymond and Marcel have lost their jack, somewhere near the fountain.
textes.Rayé de bleu, vif et nerveux. Rend un cœ: Striped with blue, quick and lively. Restores one heart.
textes.Recevoir la graine de l'esprit de l'arbr: Receive the seed from the tree spirit
textes.Redémarrage impossible : ferme l'applica: Cannot restart: close the app and launch the EXE again after Quest Link.
textes.Regarder dans la longue-vue du Belvédère: Look through the telescope at the Lookout of Colours (E, at the edge of the platform, at the very top of the Great Oak)
textes.Regarder la Palette de pierre et ses neu: Look at the Stone Palette and its nine empty paint pots
textes.Rejoindre l'île des elfes en bateau: Sail to the island of the elves
textes.Remonter les trois étoiles de mer du fon: Bring up the three starfish from the bottom of the bay, in front of the beach
textes.Remplir un pot de sauce à la Louche Sacr: Fill a jar with sauce at the Sacred Ladle (at the edge of the Cooking Pot), then ask Captain Rigatoni for the Golden Grater (his Houseboat, east of the Parmesan Beach)
textes.Rencontrer Lyra, l'elfe, au cœur de l'îl: Meet Lyra the elf in the heart of Village Island
textes.Rendre l'appareil photo à Gérard: Give the camera back to Gérard
textes.Rendre la Flamme Éternelle au Cœur-Brasi: Return the Eternal Flame to the Ember Heart (in the middle of the nave of the Forge Cathedral)
textes.Rendre la guitare et l'ampli à Rouille (: Give the guitar and the amp back to Rouille (at the Cannery in the morning, on the square in the afternoon, at the Howling Hall in the evening)
textes.Rendre le cerf-volant à Théo: Give the kite back to Théo
textes.Rendre le cochonnet à Raymond: Give the boules jack back to Raymond
textes.Rendre sa lumière au Cœur de la Flèche: Restore the light of the Spire's Heart
textes.Rendre visite au Capitaine Rigatoni, dan: Visit Captain Rigatoni in his Houseboat
textes.Rendre à l'Île Crayonnée toutes ses coul: Give Sketched Island back all its colours
textes.Retourner voir Coyotl, le potier (à son: Go back to Coyotl, the potter (at his workshop, or at the market at noon)
textes.Retourner voir Grand-Mère Aquarelle: Go back to see Grand-Mère Aquarelle
textes.Retourner voir Grand-Mère Aquarelle (dev: Go back to see Grand-Mère Aquarelle (in front of the Palette in the daytime, on the Council terrace at noon and in the evening)
textes.Retourner voir Nova (à la Serre des Espè: Go back to see Nova (at the Greenhouse of Species, in the north-east, past the Academy)
textes.Retourner voir Petit-Pierre (sur le quai: Go back to see Petit-Pierre (on the quay, by the crates, in the morning; at the fishing jetty in the afternoon; on the square in the evening)
textes.Retourner voir Pixel pour la fin de la p: Go back to see Pixel for the end of the game
textes.Retourner voir Père Gaubert (aux Champs: Go back to see Père Gaubert (in the Southern Fields, in front of his farm; in the yard at noon)
textes.Retourner voir Rosalie (à la poissonneri: Go back to see Rosalie (at the fishmonger's, on the harbour, in the morning; on a café terrace or the promenade in the afternoon)
textes.Retourner voir Rouille (à la Conserverie: Go back to see Rouille (at the Cannery in the morning, on the square or the quays in the afternoon, at the Howling Hall in the evening)
textes.Retourner voir l'archimage, dans la cour: Go back to the archmage, in the courtyard of the Great Crystal
textes.Retourner voir la Doyenne Astrée (à la S: Go back to see Elder Astrée (at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Spire; on her bench in the Agora during the auroras)
textes.Retourner voir le Révérend Père Farfalle: Go back to see Reverend Father Farfalle
textes.Retourner voir le maire, devant la mairi: Go back to the mayor, in front of the town hall
textes.Retrouver Ba Sidi, le conteur de Tazira: Find Ba Sidi, the storyteller of Tazira (on Lantern Square), who has the logbook of the Léviathan
textes.Retrouver Comète (au Spatioport, ou l'ap: Find Comète (at the Spaceport, or in the afternoon at the Zero-Gravity Garden)
textes.Retrouver Germaine-la-Terrible, la guita: Find Germaine the Terrible, Clou's guitar (at the robots' lair, in front of the gate of the Grey Factory, in the south-east, behind the Spore Wood)
textes.Retrouver Mamie Barricade (à la Conserve: Find Mamie Barricade (at the Cannery, in the assembly room on the roof, or in front of the entrance in the afternoon)
textes.Retrouver Pixel et Quark, cachés quelque: Find Pixel and Quark, hiding somewhere in Astralys (in a street corner, behind a giant plant, on a floating bench… Quark hums when he hides)
textes.Retrouver Plume-de-Nuage (une petite méd: Find Plume-de-Nuage (a little pink sky jellyfish, over by the Zero-Gravity Garden, to the west) and gently lead her back to the Greenhouse of Species: she follows you if you stay close to her
textes.Retrouver Rhubarbe au vieux camp abandon: Find Rhubarbe at the old abandoned camp (to the north-west, along the camp path), and call him at the foot of his perch with the seeds (E)
textes.Retrouver Sardine, le chien au bandana r: Find Sardine, the dog with the red bandana (at the Scrapyard, in the south-east of the island, among the car wrecks: listen carefully, he barks at the robots)
textes.Retrouver Truffe dans les bosquets au bo: Find Truffe in the thickets at the edge of the Southern Fields and ring his little bell: he'll come
textes.Retrouver Zénith (à l'Observatoire, au t: Find Zénith (at the Observatory, at the telescope, at night)
textes.Retrouver l'ampli à lampes (à la Casse,: Find the tube amp (at the Scrapyard, in the south-east, among the scrap heaps, near the Scrap dragon)
textes.Retrouver la carte volée par le chat rou: Find the map stolen by the ginger cat: he climbs onto the roofs of Tazira using crates, near the houses on the quay, east of the square
textes.Retrouver la clochette de Truffe (tombée: Find Truffe's little bell (it fell in the grass near Clovis's windmill, in the Southern Fields)
textes.Retrouver la pelote de laine rouge tombé: Find the ball of red wool that fell out of Pauline's basket (in the Grand Hotel garden)
textes.Retrouver la puce holographique envolée: Find the hologram chip that flew off during the explosion in Professor Quasar's laboratory (at the Academy of Sciences, east of the Agora)
textes.Retrouver le cerf-volant de Théo sur les: Find Théo's kite on the hills, west of the town
textes.Retrouver le chapeau à plume du Baron (l: Find the Baron's plumed hat (the wind blew it south: look on top of Clovis's windmill, in the Southern Fields)
textes.Retrouver le cochonnet, près de la fonta: Find the boules jack, near the fountain on the square
textes.Retrouver les baguettes de batterie (au: Find the drumsticks (at the Dry Dock, the skatepark, in the north-east of the town, next to the harbour)
textes.Retrouver les huit autres pots de couleu: Find the eight other paint pots and pour them into the Palette: the families know where six of them fell (Basile at the pond, Rosalie in the wood, Capucine in the meadows, Lili on the beach, Gaspard at the Lookout, Achille at the waterfall); as for the turquoise and the pink, Grandpa Augustin has a little idea
textes.Retrouver les trois fromages affinés cac: Find the three aged cheeses Biscotte has hidden around Port-Coutelas (between the crates on the quay, under the fishing jetty, near the well): follow your nose
textes.Retrouver les trois pages de la partitio: Find the three pages of sheet music (the beach, the square, the quay to the east)
textes.Retrouver les trois éclats du Cœur de la: Find the three shards of the Spire's Heart (one near the Observatory, to the north; one in the Greenhouse of Species, to the north-east; one high up in the Zero-Gravity Garden, to the west): they beat softly and sing a single note
textes.Retrouver trois pages de grimoire envolé: Find three spellbook pages that blew away around Montjoie (they glow a little: on the Great Square, in the Upper Town, in the Lower Town…)
textes.Revenir voir Agrafe (à l'imprimerie de l: Go back to see Agrafe (at the Spinning Mill print shop, or in the evening at the Expression Wall)
textes.Revenir voir Brindille (à la poste du po: Go back to Brindille (at the port post office)
textes.Revenir voir Honorine (à la boulangerie,: Go back to see Honorine (at the bakery, in the Middle Town)
textes.Revenir voir Ionie au Spatioport: Go back to see Ionie at the Spaceport
textes.Rhubarbe, le perroquet rouge de la capit: Rhubarbe, the red parrot of Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau, has flown off towards the old abandoned camp in the north-west of the island. Perroquet-Joe will know how to lure him back.
textes.Rhum ambré, eau chaude, miel et citron,: Hot water, honey and lemon, served steaming in a pewter mug. Corentin swears it cures everything. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Rien en vue pour l'instant. Explorez, re: Nothing in sight for now. Explore, meet people!
textes.Roadie d'honneur du Festival du Larsen: Honorary roadie of the Larsen Festival
textes.Rosalie Gomme, la jardinière, croit que: Rosalie Gomme, the gardener, thinks the pot of green (no. 2) rolled all the way to the Hollow Stump, the oldest stump on the island, deep in the Hatching Wood. She doesn't dare go there: a big owl lives there, and it gives her funny looks.
textes.Rosalie, c'est à qui, ce chat roux sur l: Rosalie, whose is that ginger cat on the roof?
textes.Rosalie, vous cherchez quelque chose dan: Rosalie, are you looking for something in the wood?
textes.Rouge, jaune, bleu et vert, avec une lon: Red, yellow, blue and green, with a long knotted tail. It belongs to little Théo.
textes.Rouille, la chanteuse des Rats de Cale,: Rouille, the singer of the Bilge Rats, wants you to get to know Port-Boucan. To start with: say hello to Lentille at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen, to Rustine at the bike workshop and to Sirène at the Howling Hall bar.
textes.Rouille, pourquoi tout le monde fait cet: Rouille, why the long faces everywhere?
textes.Rouille, tu peux me présenter un peu la: Rouille, could you show me around town a bit?
textes.Rustine n'a plus de pièces de vélo : les: Rustine has run out of bike parts: Lisse's robots searched the Scrapyard to build themselves arms. There are three batches of parts left, hidden in the Scrapyard, to the south-east.
textes.Réclamer la dette à Gontran Lestrange, d: Claim the debt from Gontran Lestrange, known as Jambe-de-Bois (on the Veuve Écarlate by day; at the Shark's Tooth in the evening)
textes.Récolter deux rayons de miel aux ruches: Gather two honeycombs from the fire bees' hives, in the Ash Wood (south-east of the city)
textes.Réconcilier Mamie Tournesol et Mère Aver: Make peace between Granny Sunflower and Mother Downpour
textes.Réconcilier le Grand Spaghetti Volant av: Reconcile the Great Flying Spaghetti with its followers
textes.Récupérer l'antenne de Radio Boucan (tou: Get back the Radio Boucan antenna (at the very top of the painted water tower, east of the town)
textes.Récupérer l'appareil photo de Gérard au: Get Gérard's camera back from the lookout (at the top of the hill path)
textes.Répondre aux trois questions du Sphinx (: Answer the Sphinx's three questions (on the plateau of Ra, across the river, south of Per-Hâpy)
textes.Résoudre l'énigme des serpents: Solve the riddle of the snakes
textes.Réveiller les esprits de la forêt et ouv: Wake the forest spirits and open the root gate
textes.Réveiller les trois runes de la Crypte a: Wake the three runes of the Rune Crypt with the light spell (key 5 then V; in VR, left trigger): the crypt is above the garden, on the path to the Twisted Wood
textes.Révérend, pourquoi le Grand Spaghetti a-: Reverend, why does the Great Spaghetti look so sad?
textes.S'inscrire à la Guilde des Aventuriers: Sign up at the Adventurers' Guild
textes.Saluer Edmond, à la réception du Grand H: Greet Edmond at the Grand Hotel reception
textes.Saluer Lentille à la Cantine à prix libr: Say hello to Lentille at the Pay-What-You-Can Canteen (on the ground floor of the Cannery, the big brick factory covered in murals, west of the Howling Hall)
textes.Saluer Odette à la capitainerie, sur le: Greet Odette at the harbour master's office, on the quay
textes.Saluer Rustine à l'atelier vélo (à la Fi: Say hello to Rustine at the bike workshop (in the Spinning Mill, the long brick shed with saw-tooth roofs, south of the Pallet Square)
textes.Saluer Sirène au bar de la Halle Hurlant: Say hello to Sirène at the Howling Hall bar (the old forge hall with the great glass roof, north-east of the Pallet Square)
textes.Saluer Toni au Perroquet Bleu: Greet Toni at Le Perroquet Bleu
textes.Sardine, le chien de Tornade, un bâtard: Sardine, Tornade's dog, a happy mutt with a red bandana, followed one of Lisse's robots and hasn't come back. Chaussette thinks he went towards the Scrapyard, to the south-east.
textes.Se faire inscrire au registre par Éclipt: Get Écliptique to enter you in the register (at the Council Hall, at the foot of the Crystal Spire, in the centre of the island; at noon at the Nebula Café)
textes.Se promener dans le Bois des Hachures: Take a walk in the Hatching Wood
textes.Sire Tancrède de Tournevent raconte des: Sir Tancrède de Tournevent tells tales of magnificent feats. All imaginary. He'd finally like to live a real one, with a witness: defeat the goblin chief of the Goblin Wood and bring back his banner.
textes.Sire Tancrède, racontez-moi votre plus g: Sir Tancrède, tell me about your greatest exploit.
textes.Six sardines de l'aube grillées sur la b: Six dawn sardines grilled over the embers, with cumin and lemon, on the Tazira quay. Restores two hearts.
textes.Soigner la chouette blessée du Bois Tors: Heal the injured owl in the Twisted Wood with the healing spell (key 0 then V, right next to her; in VR, left trigger)
textes.Sortir de Tazira par la porte du nord, s: Leave Tazira by the north gate, follow the three caravan markers to the north-east (they light up at night), open the tomb of the Walking Dune (the star, the dune, the sun) and take the Seal of Sands
textes.Sous le Temple de Kukulkan s'ouvre le ch: Beneath the Temple of Kukulkan lies the road to Xibalba, the kingdom of the Lords of Death. Ix Kanul, the high priestess, would like someone to go down there like the Twins of the Popol Vuh, and bring back the Jade Mask of the kings of Yaxché.
textes.Sœur Pétronille, la prêtresse du Temple: Sister Pétronille, the priestess of the Temple of Dawn, was praying by the Frog Lake when the biggest giant frog in the lake swallowed her sun rosary. Without it, she doesn't dare go adventuring any more.
textes.Ta Chanson du Roi de la Bagarre… il lui: Your Song of the Brawl King… is it missing a verse?
textes.Taillées par Coralin dans du corail et d: Carved by Coralin from coral and shark teeth, ribbed with mother-of-pearl. As long as they're in your bag, you swim one and a half times faster.
textes.Tant que l'Usine Grise de Lisse & Fils f: As long as the Lisse & Sons Grey Factory keeps building robots, the raids will go on. Mamie Barricade knows that the plans for the Lisse-Center are kept at the very bottom of the factory, underground, guarded by Mr Lisse's favourite machine: the Great Digger. You need to go down the five floors, defeat the machine and bring back the plans.
textes.Tazira, le pont de la Murène Noire: Tazira, the deck of the Murène Noire
textes.Théophraste Filandre m'apprend la téléki: Théophraste Filandre is teaching me telekinesis. Four of his books flew away during the great storm and are stuck where no one can climb: I have to bring them back down.
textes.Tobias, le calfat, doit reboucher une vo: Tobias, the caulker, has to patch a leak in the hull of the Léviathan. He needs good timber.
textes.Tom le Violoneux chantera la gloire de c: Tom the Fiddler will sing the glory of whoever knocks down the port's three champions with their fists: Gros-Louis of the Requin Borgne, the Mute of the Veuve Écarlate and Belle-Humeur of the Morue Enragée.
textes.Tombée d'un cocotier abattu. Son lait re: Fallen from a felled coconut palm. Its milk restores one heart.
textes.Ton chat… je peux le chercher ?: Your cat… can I look for it?
textes.Ton moustique… tu me le prêterais ?: Your mosquito… would you lend it to me?
textes.Ton perroquet… je peux le chercher ?: Your parrot… can I look for it?
textes.Toni n'a plus de noix de coco pour son c: Toni has run out of coconuts for his famous punch.
textes.Traverser le Lac Miroir sur un chemin de: Cross Mirror Lake on a path of ice (frost spell, key 7 then V, facing the islet; in VR, left trigger) and touch the Frost Crystal (E)
textes.Trois dés d'os qui roulent un peu… mieux: Three bone dice that roll a little… better than the others, sold on the sly by Isaac Cinq-Doigts. You can play dice with them. But if the pirate across from you notices (one time in three), it's a brawl.
textes.Trois galettes de maïs encore chaudes, c: Three corn cakes still warm, cooked on Ix Chab's clay griddle, folded around a few beans and some chilli. Restores two hearts.
textes.Trois grands tournesols du jardin de Mam: Three tall sunflowers from Granny Sunflower's garden, tied with a yellow ribbon. They turn their heads towards you, as if towards the sun.
textes.Troquer la fiole de brume avec Ursule, l: Swap the vial of mist with Ursule, the blacksmith (the bears' forge, south-east of the village)
textes.Troquer la plume de lune avec Pivoine, l: Swap the moon feather with Pivoine, the herbalist, at the Herb Stall (halfway up the Mother Oak)
textes.Troquer le caillou-qui-chante avec Pomme: Swap the singing-stone with Pomme-de-Pin, the bridge carpenter (on the western tree in the morning, near the big pond in the afternoon)
textes.Troquer le gland d'or avec Plumette, à l: Swap the golden acorn with Plumette, at the Post Office, right at the top of the Mother Oak
textes.Trouver Brioche, la chatte rousse et bla: Find Brioche, the ginger-and-white cat, on the harbour rooftops (near the fishmonger's and the harbour master's office), show her the ball of wool and let her come to you: she's the one who chooses
textes.Trouver Monsieur Paille, l'épouvantail,: Find Mr Paille, the scarecrow, in the middle of the White Meadows (east of the village), and take the pot of red at his feet
textes.Trouver deux morceaux de la carte : dans: Find two pieces of the map: in the keep of the Cursed Fort (on the eastern point) and in the graveyard mausoleum (on the western hill) — watch out for skeletons, especially at night
textes.Trouver l'Atlantide et rallumer son Gran: Find Atlantis and rekindle its Great Crystal
textes.Trouver l'entrée du temple sous le villa: Find the entrance to the temple under the village (a hidden trapdoor)
textes.Trouver la Bergerie du Vent, au pied du: Find the Wind Sheepfold, at the foot of Stoneheart south-east of Cliquetis, burn its brambles with the Flame (key 2 then X; in VR, B), and take the Bronze Seal
textes.Trouver la Souche Creuse, au fond du Boi: Find the Hollow Stump, deep in the Hatching Wood (to the west, at the end of the woodland path), and take the pot of green from it
textes.Trouver le calme au Jardin Zen: Find peace in the Zen Garden
textes.Trouver le grand château de sable de l'A: Find the big Averse sandcastle, at the far end of the White Strand (to the west), and take the pot of yellow at the foot of its tower
textes.Trouver trois lots de pièces de vélo cac: Find three batches of bike parts hidden in the Scrapyard (in the south-east of the island, under the scrap heaps)
textes.Trouver une première Perle de Lumière: Find a first Pearl of Light
textes.Truffe, le plus petit des cochons de la: Truffe, the smallest of the pigs on Old Man Gaubert's farm, pink and black, runs away every day to root around in the woods at the edge of the Southern Fields. He digs up truffles… and the turnips. Old Man Gaubert, with his knees, can't catch him any more, and his little bell has fallen off. He's looking for someone who likes walking to take him along.
textes.Tu me ferais une jarre de pluie ?: Would you make me a rain jar?
You don't have any seal power yet.
textes.Tu ne connais encore aucun sort. Les maî: You don't know any spell yet. The masters of Arcanelle, the wizards' island, teach six of them.
textes.Tu t'élèves de cinq ou six mètres, tu pl: You rise five or six metres, hover a moment, and float gently back down.
textes.Un anneau d'or fin avec un petit diamant: A fine gold ring with a small diamond, engraved on the inside: "H & L, forever".
textes.Un anneau de verre taillé de la grande l: A ring of cut glass from the lighthouse's great lens. It focuses light like a giant magnifying glass.
textes.Un appareil photo holographique, un peu: A holographic camera, a little sticky (Glorb is gelatinous). It takes photos in three dimensions, and sometimes in four.
textes.Un badge en plastique gris, avec une pho: A grey plastic badge, with a photo of someone who isn't smiling and the words "ACCESS: EVERYTHING. SMILING: FORBIDDEN." It opens the doors on the lower floor of the Grey Factory.
textes.Un badge rond qui brille, avec ton nom é: A round, shiny badge, with your name written in Lumen letters (which look like little dancing stars): "VERY WELCOME VISITOR — HEAVY-FEET, BUT KIND".
textes.Un batteur pour les Rats de Cale: A drummer for the Bilge Rats
textes.Un biscuit en forme de croissant de lune: A crescent-moon biscuit, sprinkled with silver sugar. Crunchy on one side, soft on the other (the Lumens can't make up their minds). Restores one heart.
textes.Un bocal de « soupe de tout le monde »,: A jar of steaming "everyone's soup", with a pallet-wood lid made by Copeau. You never know exactly what's in it, but it's always good. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un bol fumant de ragoût aux champignons: A steaming bowl of ember mushroom stew. It burns your tongue and restores four hearts.
textes.Un café noir comme la lave refroidie, to: A coffee as black as cooled lava, roasted on the Ember Heart itself, served piping hot at Au Diable Repu. Restores one heart, and wide-open eyes.
textes.Un caillou lisse. Servira à fabriquer de: A smooth pebble. Good for making tools.
textes.Un caillou noir et lourd, encore un peu: A heavy black stone, still a little warm, that fell from the sky onto Astralys on a night of shooting stars. It has an iron sheen and smells like stormy rain.
textes.Un canard de laiton à remontoir. Il nage: A wind-up brass duck. It swims, it quacks, it doesn't lay eggs.
textes.Un cercle de bois tressé d'un filet de c: A wooden hoop woven with a hemp net, with beads and feathers. The net catches bad dreams; the good ones slide down the feathers.
textes.Un champignon au chapeau violet, constel: A mushroom with a purple cap, dotted with spots that shine like stars. Lulu says it takes you to the fairy kingdom, above the clouds. "Bite" it to make the journey; up there, the mushroom ring will bring you back to the beach.
textes.Un champignon féerique au chapeau orange: A fairy mushroom with an orange cap, on a spiral stalk that bounces all by itself. "Munch": you jump three times higher and float gently back down (for a while). A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon féerique aux lamelles de t: A fairy mushroom with gills of every colour. "Munch": the world ripples with colours, you run faster, and you leave a rainbow trail. A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon féerique pâle et argenté q: A pale, silvery fairy mushroom that glows like a little piece of the moon. "Munch": you can see the invisible (glowing hiding places appear all over the island). A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon féerique violet aux lamell: A purple fairy mushroom with gills shaped like a little mouth, which goes "blah blah blah" when you hold it up to your ear. "Munch": you understand animals. A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un champignon rouge et tiède qui pousse: A red, warm mushroom that grows in the ash, near the steam vents. Dagna puts it in her stew. Restores one heart.
textes.Un chapelet de perles de bois clair, ave: A string of pale wooden beads, with a little gold sun at the end. Sister Pétronille's, swallowed by the Queen Frog of the lake. It smells a little of mud (and a lot of frog).
textes.Un chat roux a volé la carte au trésor d: A ginger cat has stolen the treasure map of Captain Croc-de-Sel, the pirate moored at Tazira. And cats climb
A ginger cat has stolen the treasure map of Captain Croc-de-Sel, the pirate moored at Tazira. And cats climb…
textes.Un chiffon rouge troué, cloué sur un bât: A red rag full of holes, nailed to a stick, with a big tooth painted on it (crookedly). The banner of the goblin chief of the Goblin Wood. Sir Tancrède wants to bring it back as proof of his first real feat.
textes.Un cidre brut des pommiers de la côte ou: A dry sparkling apple drink from the west coast orchards, fizzing like the sea on a windy day. Restores one heart.
textes.Un colosse des eaux profondes, au bout d: A giant of the deep waters, at the end of the jetties. Restores three hearts.
textes.Un cristal bleu, froid comme le soir, ga: A blue crystal, cold as the evening, guarded by the suits of armour in the armoury. It fits into the Seal of the Winds.
textes.Un cristal bleu-violet qui pousse sous l: A blue-violet crystal that grows beneath the floating island of Astralys and hums very softly, as if it were singing to itself. The Lumens make engines, lamps and music boxes out of it.
textes.Un cristal d'un jaune vif, en aiguilles,: A bright yellow crystal in needles, picked up at the edge of the hot springs. It smells of eggs and matches. Zigomar, the fireworks maker, makes his finest rockets with it.
textes.Un cristal doré, tiède comme le soleil d: A golden crystal, warm as the morning sun, won by ringing the Citadel's bell tower. It fits into the Seal of the Winds.
textes.Un cristal violet, cueilli au sommet des: A purple crystal, gathered at the top of the Fangs, where lightning strikes most often. A little yellow spark runs inside it; it crackles when you squeeze it. Violette needs it for her great spell.
textes.Un croc blanc, long comme un doigt, enco: A white fang, as long as a finger, still warm. Kraxx, the armourer, says it makes very good arrowheads (and very good toothpicks).
textes.Un croissant doré du Pain Doré, encore t: A golden croissant from the Pain Doré, still warm, that leaves crumbs everywhere. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Un cuissot de cerf enveloppé dans une fe: A haunch of venison wrapped in a banana leaf, from Balam's hunt. Not for you: for an offering. The Twins of the Popol Vuh knew who to give it to.
textes.Un des livres de la bibliothèque d'Arcan: One of the books from the library of Arcanelle, blown away during the great storm. Its pages still flap a little, like wings. Théophraste is waiting for them.
textes.Un disque d'argent pâle où dort un crois: A pale silver disc where a crescent moon sleeps; a light mist always drifts from it. The seal of Ramure. It awakened the Moonglow in you.
textes.Un disque d'or rouge, chaud comme une pi: A disc of red gold, warm as a stone in the sun, engraved with a sun rising over a dune. The seal of the desert. It awakened the Flame in you.
textes.Un disque de bronze aux bords dentés, qu: A bronze disc with toothed edges, which spins by itself when laid flat. The seal of the highlands. It awakened the Cog in you.
textes.Un disque de nacre bleu-vert, frais comm: A blue-green mother-of-pearl disc, cool as a wave, engraved with a compass rose. The seal of Carène. It awakened the Gust in you.
textes.Un engrenage de laiton aux dents bien ta: A brass gear with neatly cut teeth, from the workshops of Cliquetis. It turns all by itself if you blow on it (no, that's not true, but it's nice to say).
textes.Un engrenage de quatorze dents, en or ma: A fourteen-tooth gear of solid gold, engraved "F. Cogne". The Fair's perpetual motion engine is missing it.
textes.Un flocon tombé sur les falaises du nord: A snowflake that fell on the northern cliffs of Arcanelle. It doesn't melt, even in the palm of your hand. Borée Givrelin makes it the key to the frost spell.
textes.Un galet percé de petits trous. Quand le: A pebble pierced with little holes. When the wind blows through it, it whistles a clear note. The start of Bedaine's Great Swap.
textes.Un gland doré, tout brillant, trouvé à l: A golden acorn, all shiny, found at the top of the Mother Oak. The owls of Ramure love them.
textes.Un grand coquillage rose et blanc, coupé: A big pink and white shell, cut in a spiral: the conch of the wind god, Ehécatl. When you blow into it, you hear the sea, and the wind rises.
textes.Un grand feutre violet, un galon d'or, e: A big purple felt hat, with gold braid and a white feather as long as an arm. Baron Barthélemy's favourite hat. It flies off at the slightest gust of wind, and the Baron searches the whole island for it.
textes.Un grand plat doré : les tagliatelles de: A big golden dish: Mamma Lasagna's tagliatelle, the sacred sauce from the Cooking Pot, three meatballs, and a snowfall of parmesan grated with the Golden Grater. To be placed on the altar of the Colander Temple, so the Great Spaghetti stops sulking.
textes.Un grand rouleau de plans tout gris : qu: A big roll of all-grey plans: four hundred shops, two thousand parking spaces, a fountain that plays an anthem, and where the Howling Hall stands… a car park. To bring back to Mamie Barricade.
textes.Un grand verre de jus de pomme du verger: A tall glass of apple juice from the farm orchard, cloudy and sweet, pressed that very morning. Restores one heart.
textes.Un grand verre de sirop de menthe à l'ea: A tall glass of mint cordial, green like Pigment's crest, with a paper straw. Tornade's favourite drink (and the Sergeant's, secretly). Restores one heart.
textes.Un grelot de cuivre au bout d'un cordon: A copper bell on a red cord, which the tanukis hang from their belts. The sign of a true master of swapping.
textes.Un gros boulon gris, tombé d'un robot dé: A big grey bolt that fell off one of Mr Lisse's removal robots. Rustine, Ferraille and Fusible buy them back to make things far more useful than robots.
textes.Un gros gâteau rond du Four Éternel de B: A big round cake from Bobor's Eternal Oven, glazed with fire honey that runs down the sides. They say Cerberus, the three-headed dog, loves them: one per head. Restores two hearts (if you don't keep it for the dog).
textes.Un gros livre de cuir violet, une étoile: A big book of purple leather, with a gold star on the cover. Its pages were blank: each spell learned from a master of Arcanelle has written itself there, in purple ink.
textes.Un gâteau rond à la châtaigne et au miel: A round chestnut and honey cake with a moon drawn on top. In Ramure, they eat it every feast night. Restores three hearts.
textes.Un haut-de-forme équipé d'un petit venti: A top hat fitted with a little hand-cranked fan. To keep your ideas cool.
textes.Un minuscule carré de cristal. Quand on: A tiny square of crystal. When you blow on it, a little hologram pops out and takes a bow.
textes.Un minuscule champignon féerique bleu, t: A tiny blue fairy mushroom, very proud, puffing out its cap. "Munch": you suddenly grow big and hit harder (for a while). A storybook mushroom: in a real forest, you must NEVER eat a mushroom you don't know.
textes.Un morceau d'amulette en jade, gravé d'u: A piece of jade amulet, engraved with an ancient symbol. You need three to open the Serpent Gate, deep inside the Sunken Temple.
textes.Un morceau de fromage qui a beaucoup voy: A piece of cheese that has travelled a lot, with a golden rind and a… brave smell. For a rat, it's a treasure.
textes.Un morceau de lumière tombé du ciel une: A piece of light fallen from the sky on a clear night, pale and warm. Aurélien Lumen needs it to teach the light spell.
textes.Un moustique dans une petite calebasse f: A mosquito in a little gourd closed with a leaf stopper. Kinich swears its name is Xan, like the Twins' one, and that it stings liars.
textes.Un navet fuyard des Champs du Sud, attra: A runaway turnip from the Southern Fields, caught during an alert: it's golden, it has little arms, and it's sulking. The Guild buys it back; so do Babette and Ulric (for soup).
textes.Un nid de tagliatelles dorées, faites à: A nest of golden tagliatelle, handmade this morning by Mamma Lasagna, "while singing". For the Great Reconciliation dish. Don't squash it, don't break it, don't eat it on the way.
textes.Un os à mâcher qui sent bon le jambon, d: A chew bone that smells deliciously of ham, from Chaussette's shop. For Sardine, the dog with the red bandana: "Give" when he's with you.
textes.Un pain rond et plat, cuit contre la par: A round, flat loaf, baked against the wall of Mérit's oven, with a little sand in it (everyone has sand in their bread in Per-Hâpy). Restores two hearts.
textes.Un panier d'osier des Jardins Partagés :: A wicker basket from the Shared Gardens: leeks, squashes, potatoes, and a carrot with a tiny bite taken out of it. For everyone's soup.
textes.Un parapluie noir, comme tous ceux de Ra: A black umbrella, like all the ones in Rainville… but underneath, when you open it, there are painted sunflowers. Mother Downpour made it fifty years ago, for her best friend.
textes.Un parapluie rouge surmonté d'une hélice: A red umbrella topped with a propeller. When you open the umbrella, the propeller spins. It's no use at all, but it's very pretty.
textes.Un parchemin roulé, un sceau rouge, une: A rolled-up parchment, a red seal, a little cottage drawn in the corner: "The Wisteria Cottage, Montjoie Upper Town, now belongs to its new owner. Wisteria included." Signed: Mr Prosper.
textes.Un parchemin roussi aux coins, scellé de: A parchment singed at the corners, sealed with red wax: "Bachelor of Flames, with the (slightly burnt) congratulations of the jury". Signed: Professor Malachar.
textes.Un petit champignon des mares de Ramure,: A little mushroom from the ponds of Ramure, with a pale blue cap, that glows softly at night. Mère-Lune puts them in the bridge lanterns.
textes.Un petit croc jaune, perdu par un gobeli: A small yellow fang, lost by a goblin from the Goblin Wood (he has others, and a stolen sock in each pocket). Master Hugues makes necklaces with them.
textes.Un petit piment rouge et luisant, du mar: A small, shiny red chilli from Zébuline's market. Demons crunch them like cherries. You're going to cry. Restores one heart (smoke out of the ears included free).
textes.Un petit pot de peinture en fer-blanc, c: A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "1". Inside, the blue of Sketched Island (the Rubbed-Out Pond, the sky in the water, the streams). To be poured into cup no. 1 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "2". Inside, the green of Sketched Island (the leaves, the grass, the moss of the Hatching Wood). To be poured into cup no. 2 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "3". Inside, the red of Sketched Island (the poppies of the White Meadows). To be poured into cup no. 3 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "4". Inside, the yellow of Sketched Island (the sand of the White Strand). To be poured into cup no. 4 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "5". Inside, the brown of Sketched Island (the wood of the village, the earth of the clearing). To be poured into cup no. 5 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "6". Inside, the purple of Sketched Island (the heather of Mount Charcoal). To be poured into cup no. 6 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "7". Inside, the orange of Sketched Island (the Ink Waterfall at sunset). To be poured into cup no. 7 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "8". Inside, the turquoise of Sketched Island (the Dotted Stream, all the way to the sea). To be poured into cup no. 8 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.

A small tin pot of paint, dented by the Great Downpour, with a label: "9". Inside, the pink of Sketched Island (the flowers of the south-western meadows). To be poured into cup no. 9 of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the Giants' Clearing.
textes.Un petit pot de sauce tomate, puisé à la: A small jar of tomato sauce, scooped with the giant ladle from the Cooking Pot of Mount Bolognese: tomato, garlic, basil, a pinch of sugar. Still warm. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un petit sifflet en os sculpté, avec un: A little carved bone whistle, with a dog, a cat, a rat and a pig engraved all around it. "Use": choose which companion comes with you.
textes.Un poisson noble qui se défend bien. Ren: A noble fish that puts up a good fight. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Un pot de gelée verte, tremblotante, qui: A jar of wobbly green jelly that goes "bloop" when you shake it. Aubin, the apothecary, makes ointments with it; Madame Olga, potions; the children, mischief.
textes.Un rayon de miel trouvé dans un arbre cr: A honeycomb found in a hollow tree. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un ressort tout brillant, tombé d'un rob: A shiny spring that fell off one of Lisse's robots. It goes "boing" when you let go of it. Ferraille puts them in her sculptures; Cradoc in his shoes.
textes.Un rouage neuf forgé par Hector pour l'h: A new cogwheel forged by Hector for the town hall clock. It shines like a gold coin.
textes.Un rouleau de toile épaisse, tissée serr: A roll of thick, tightly woven canvas that smells of salt and hemp. For ships' sails… and the wings of flying machines.
textes.Un sablé en forme d'engrenage, au beurre: A gear-shaped shortbread, with butter and cinnamon. The teeth are crunchy. Restores two hearts.
textes.Un sac de toile plein de chaînes, de péd: A canvas bag full of chains, pedals, spokes, brake pads, and a bell shaped like a rat. Ferraille had hidden them for Rustine.
textes.Un second saut en plein vol (Espace, ou: A second jump in mid-air (Space, or A in VR, a second time in the air).
textes.Un serre-tête avec deux oreilles de rena: A headband with two red felt fox ears with black tips. A gift from Mère-Lune: in Ramure, they take you for one of their own.
textes.Un sifflet qui ne fait aucun bruit. L'in: A whistle that makes no sound at all. The inventor insists it's perfect for calling fish.
textes.Un sorbet de fruits rouges et de cannell: A sorbet of red berries and fire cinnamon, served in an obsidian cup: hot inside, ice-cold outside (or the other way round, nobody agrees). Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Un souffle de mécanique : il remet en ma: A mechanical breath: it restarts old mechanisms from afar and paralyses automatons.
textes.Un souffle glacé : les ennemis se figent: An icy breath: enemies freeze; on a lake, a path of ice.
textes.Un thé bleu nuit où flottent des paillet: A midnight-blue tea with flecks of gold floating in it, served at the Nebula Café. It tastes of mint, rain and something else that no one can quite name. Restores one heart.
textes.Un tiers de parchemin jauni, déchiré en: A third of a yellowed parchment, torn in a zigzag, covered in dotted lines, arrows and stains: a piece of Barbe-Sanglante's map.
textes.Un tricorne de feutre noir galonné d'or,: A black felt tricorn trimmed with gold braid, a red feather stuck in the side: Barbe-Sanglante's own, which Old Silas kept for a hundred years for the heir to the treasure.
textes.Un vent du large qui repousse les ennemi: A sea wind that pushes enemies back, flips shells over, turns sails and windmills.
textes.Un vieil ampli à lampes, lourd comme un: An old tube amp, heavy as a donkey, with knobs that go up to eleven. When you switch it on, it purrs. When Clou plays, it roars.
textes.Un vieux parchemin offert par Églantine,: An old parchment given by Églantine, the freed Bramble Queen. It shows the passage through the reefs and the ashes, to the west, all the way to the dwarves' volcanic island.
textes.Un vieux parchemin taché de rhum : une c: An old stained parchment: a coastline, dotted lines, a red cross. Captain Salazar Croc-de-Sel cares about it more than his wooden leg.
textes.Un visage de roi fait de centaines de pe: A king's face made of hundreds of little squares of jade, with eyes of mother-of-pearl and obsidian. The mask of the kings of Yaxché, kept deep in Xibalba. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
textes.Un éclat de cristal qui bat doucement, c: A shard of crystal that beats gently, like a heart. It is warm, and it sings a single, very pure note.
textes.Un éclat de glace bleue qui ne fond jama: A shard of blue ice that never melts, even in your hand, even in Pandémonia. It comes from the Cocytus, the frozen lake of the Ninth Circle.
textes.Un éclat rose et tiède, laissé par une a: A pink, warm shard, left behind by a crystal spider. Grommelot the sprite collects them; Mélisse buys them.
textes.Un écusson brodé : un rat à crête verte: An embroidered patch: a yelling green-crested rat, and "BILGE RATS" in red letters. Velours sews them herself, one by one, for the true fans.
textes.Un élixir doré qui pétille comme un ciel: A golden elixir that sparkles like a summer sky. It restores all your magic, and two hearts. Gustave won't say what he puts in it.
textes.Un œil d'or et de lapis-lazuli, l'œil qu: An eye of gold and lapis lazuli, the eye the god Horus lost fighting Set and that Thoth healed: the sign of the light that always comes back. Brought back from the depths of the Pyramid of Ra. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
textes.Une affiche sérigraphiée, encore odorant: A screen-printed poster that still smells of ink: a green-crested rat yells into a microphone, and in dancing letters: "THE GREAT BOUCAN — THE BILGE RATS — FREE, LOUD, AND FULL OF LOVE". To take to the other islands.
textes.Une amulette de faïence bleue en forme d: A blue faience amulet shaped like a scarab, its underside engraved with little signs. The scarab is Khepri, the morning sun reborn. Ptahmose carves them; they say they bring luck.
textes.Une amulette de pierre verte en forme de: An amulet of green stone in the shape of a face, warm under your fingers: a piece of the body of Osiris, which Set had scattered. Four of them are needed for the sarcophagus of Osiris.
textes.Une antenne de radio tordue, faite d'un: A bent radio antenna, made from an old rake, a coat hanger and lots of sticky tape. It picks up everything: radio waves, the wind, and sometimes the seagulls' conversations.
textes.Une bague de marin, avec une pierre bleu: A sailor's ring with a blue stone. Octave buys it for 18 coins.
textes.Une baguette croustillante de Margaux. O: A crusty baguette from Margaux. Half of it gets eaten before you reach home. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une baguette de fée en bois de sureau, t: A fairy wand of elderwood, tipped with a crystal star. Pimprenelle lost it in the Cave of the Jumping Mushrooms.
textes.Une bombe de peinture faite maison par P: A homemade spray can by Pigment (made with beetroot, spinach or blueberry: it smells a bit like soup). In front of a paintable wall in Port-Boucan (the Expression Wall, bare walls): E to paint a graffiti.
textes.Une botte de spaghettis séchés au Séchoi: A bundle of spaghetti dried at the Drying Shed of Al Dente Island, made with durum wheat from its fields. Tied with a green, white and red ribbon.
textes.Une boule de feu : elle brûle les ennemi: A fireball: it burns enemies and brambles, lights braziers and torches.
textes.Une boule de feu qui file droit devant :: A fireball that flies straight ahead: it burns enemies and lights braziers and torches.
A ball of light follows you for a minute. It lights up the dark and wakes sleeping runes.
textes.Une bourse de cuir rouge brodée d'une ve: A red leather purse embroidered with a black widow spider, heavy with forty coins: Gontran Lestrange's debt to Mama Grog.
textes.Une bourse de poussière qui scintille de: A pouch of dust that sparkles in every colour, found in the chest of the Fairy Garden. Lumi says you'll need a lot of it to get past the brambles.
textes.Une boussole qui indique le sud. Des deu: A compass that points south. At both ends. So you never get lost heading south.
textes.Une branche de corail rouge du fond de l: A branch of red coral from the bottom of the bay. Ground up, it makes a brilliant pigment.
textes.Une branche solide. Servira à fabriquer: A sturdy branch. Good for making tools.
textes.Une canette glacée sortie d'un distribut: An ice-cold can from a Neopolis vending machine. "Sparkling Moon Fruit": nobody knows what moon fruit tastes like, but it's good. It glows a little in the dark. Restores one heart.
textes.Une carte de cuir épais, à ton nom, avec: A card of thick leather, with your name, your portrait (very lifelike, except the nose) and the letter of your rank in a red circle. Églantine stamps it for every contract completed. Clac, the stamp, has left its mark on it.
textes.Une carte du ciel dessinée à l'encre de: A sky map drawn in ink of light: the stars move gently across it, in time with the real ones.
textes.Une carte postale de Port-Azur : le phar: A postcard from Port-Azur: the lighthouse, the bay, and on the back, Nadine's round handwriting.
textes.Une chatte tigrée rousse et blanche, trè: A very dignified ginger-and-white tabby cat lives on the rooftops of Port-Azur harbour. Every morning, she pinches a sardine from Rosalie, the fishmonger. Rosalie calls her Brioche. She'd like her to finally have someone of her own. Brioche won't let anyone come near her… except, perhaps, someone with a ball of wool.
textes.Une chope de bière brune et mousseuse br: A mug of dark, foamy fizz brewed beneath the mountain. Restores one and a half hearts… and warms your ears.
textes.Une clé d'argent ciselée de petits hibou: A silver key engraved with little owls, found in the only chest in the Library of Mimics that doesn't bite. It opens the stairway to the top floor.
textes.Une clé de cuivre vert-de-grisé, un peu: A verdigris copper key, a little slimy: it was in the belly of a giant frog in the Underground Lake. It opens the gate on the third floor of the dungeon.
textes.Une copie, faite par Amenemhat le scribe: A copy, made by Amenemhat the scribe, of the papyrus that sleeps in the pyramid: Thoth, the ibis-headed god, points to a royal cartouche. Three signs, one under the other: an ibis, an eye, a sun.
textes.Une corde solide, tordue à la main à la: A sturdy rope, twisted by hand at Galet's Ropeworks, with hemp from the island's fields. It smells of straw and sunshine.
textes.Une coupe sculptée dans le bois du Chêne: A cup carved from the wood of the Mother Oak, engraved with a running rabbit. Bondi kept it for three years. Now it's yours.
textes.Une cuisse de grenouille géante du lac,: A giant frog leg from the lake, as big as a ham. Ulric grills it with garlic at "La Grenouille Repue". Restores one and a half hearts (and tastes like chicken, apparently).
textes.Une dent de tyrannosaure longue comme un: A tyrannosaurus tooth as long as an arm… made of little squares, like everything that comes from Pixelithic Island. Grosse-Dent lost it when he fell asleep. The Clan says it brings luck (as long as you don't give it back).
textes.Une dent jaune et pointue, dure comme l': A pointed yellow tooth, hard as steel, taken from a crocodile of the Drowned Marsh. Brutus sets them in his iron fists; Isaac Cinq-Doigts buys them for six coins.
textes.Une dent longue comme un avant-bras, jau: A tooth as long as a forearm, yellowed by a hundred years of swamp: Vieille-Dent's, the giant crocodile. Isaac Cinq-Doigts offers forty coins for it.
textes.Une dent triangulaire, coupante comme un: A triangular tooth, sharp as a razor, lost by a shark from the Coral garden. Coralin, the craftsman of Atlantis, makes flippers from them.
textes.Une enveloppe cachetée de cire rouge, ac: An envelope sealed with red wax, bought at the post office. Perfect for a declaration of love.
textes.Une enveloppe épaisse, cachetée de cire: A thick envelope, sealed with red wax, with the recipient's name written in round, careful letters. Brindille, the winged postwoman, is counting on you.
An elven vial, thin as a bubble. Lyra entrusted it to you to draw the spring water from the pool of the great waterfall (north-east of Village Island).
textes.Une flamme d'or qui danse dans une coupe: A golden flame dancing in a crystal cup, with no wood or oil. It doesn't burn your fingers: it warms your heart. Stolen by the Frost Titan; its place is in the Ember Heart of the Forge Cathedral.
textes.Une fleur aux pétales de flamme, jaune a: A flower with petals of flame, yellow at the heart, red at the tips, which only grows on the slopes of the Great Blaze. It stays warm in your hand. Mother Brasille needs it for her flowerbeds.
textes.Une fleur aux pétales translucides dans: A flower with translucent petals in which tiny galaxies swirl.
textes.Une fleur blanche aux pétales lumineux,: A white flower with glowing petals, picked from the top of a jungle peak. It never wilts.
textes.Une fois toutes les dix minutes, un coup: Once every ten minutes, a blow that should knock you out leaves you at half a heart.
textes.Une galette de pain moelleuse, dorée au: A soft flatbread, baked golden in the Borgo oven, studded with rosemary and coarse salt, glistening with olive oil. Mamma Lasagna bakes three batches a day. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Une gelée violette qui tremble toute seu: A purple jelly that wobbles all by itself and sparkles, Gloubi's speciality. It tickles your tongue. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une goutte de rosée qui ne s'évapore jam: A dewdrop that never evaporates and shines like a little moon. Brindille the fairy is looking for five.
textes.Une graine dorée, grosse comme un œuf, v: A golden seed as big as an egg, veined with light: the first seed of the World Tree in a hundred years. The spirit of the tree entrusted it to you for the fairies. It is warm, and it seems to breathe.
textes.Une graine dorée, lourde et tiède. Barna: A golden seed, heavy and warm. Barnabé found it on a beach twenty years ago. It comes from the elves' Mother Tree.
textes.Une graine ronde et tiède qui luit comme: A round, warm seed that glows like a night-light. Photon says it grows into a flower that sings when the sun rises.
textes.Une grande assiette de spaghettis de Mam: A big plate of Mamma Lasagna's spaghetti, covered in volcano sauce, with three meatballs and a snowfall of parmesan. Blessed (a little) by the Noodles. Restores three hearts.
textes.Une grande feuille signée par Monsieur A: A large sheet signed by Mr Aldric Lisse (very small) and by all of Port-Boucan (very big, with drawings): "The old port belongs to those who live in it, bring it to life and share it. Forever."
textes.Une grande plume dorée. Utilise-la (ou G: A large golden feather. Use it (or G on PC, X button in VR) to call Ventaile: she arrives and lands near you. Then E (trigger) to climb onto her back.
textes.Une grosse clé de fer noir, tiède, une f: A big key of black iron, warm, with a golden flame in the ring. Brother Cendrin, the keeper of the Ember Heart, guards it: it opens the gate of the Nine Circles, at the back of the Forge Cathedral.
textes.Une grosse clé de laiton, accrochée à un: A big brass key, tied to a cork (so it floats). It opens the captain's cabin of the Baleine Rouillée, the old freighter that houses Radio Boucan.
textes.Une grosse tomate de la Tomateraie de l': A big tomato from the Tomato Grove of Al Dente Island, heavy, ribbed, warm from the sun. Restores one heart.
textes.Une jarre bleue au visage de Tlaloc, le: A blue jar with the face of Tlaloc, the god of rain: big round eyes, fangs, a moustache. Coyotl, the potter of Aztlán, shaped it and filled it with lake water for the offering.
textes.Une jolie boîte de bois marquée « RIEN »: A pretty wooden box marked "NOTHING". It contains exactly what it says on it.
textes.Une large ceinture de cuir clouté, à la: A wide studded leather belt, with a fist-shaped brass buckle. Nobody had worn it for forty years, until you knocked out the three champions of Port-Coutelas.
textes.Une longue plume blanche aux reflets ble: A long white feather with blue glints, lost by the wind when it spins too fast. It weighs almost nothing. Zéphyrine Plume needs it to teach levitation.
textes.Une longue plume noire aux reflets bleus: A long black feather with blue glints, lost by an ash raven. Hilda makes arrows out of them… and hats.
textes.Une longue plume noire aux reflets rouge: A long black feather with red glints, lost by a Fury at the gate of Dis. It smells of smoke and anger, but it's very pretty.
textes.Une longue plume rouge vif au bout bleu,: A long bright red feather with a blue tip, given by Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau: the one Rhubarbe lost the day she found him.
textes.Une longue plume rouge vif, d'un ara de: A long bright red feather, from a macaw of the Yaxché jungle. Ix Sak, the feather weaver, sells them. They say that in Xibalba, a red feather shines like a flame that doesn't burn.
textes.Une lumière de lune autour de toi : elle: Moonlight around you: it reveals what is hidden (bridges, slabs, writings) and makes ghosts vulnerable.
textes.Une miche ronde, croustillante, fendue e: A round, crusty loaf, scored with a cross and dusted with flour, from Honorine's bakery. Still warm. Restores one heart.
textes.Une montre de gousset dont les aiguilles: A pocket watch whose hands turn the other way. It keeps perfect time, but backwards.
textes.Une page arrachée au grand grimoire de M: A page torn from Madame Olga's great spellbook: a magic circle drawn in purple ink, notes in the margin ("do not read aloud", "nor quietly"). It glows a little in the dark.
textes.Une page de « La Valse d'Azur », la chan: A page of "La Valse d'Azur", Django's song. The notes are a little faded by the sea spray.
textes.Une paire de baguettes de batterie en ér: A pair of maple drumsticks, chewed at the tips, with "BILGE RATS" carved in with a knife. They're waiting for someone who can keep a good beat.
textes.Une pelote de laine rouge vif, un peu dé: A ball of bright red wool, a little unravelled. No cat in the world can resist it. Not even very dignified cats.
textes.Une perle bien ronde, sortie d'un trésor: A perfectly round pearl, taken from a buried treasure. Octave buys it for 10 coins.
textes.Une perle grosse comme une prune, qui lu: A pearl as big as a plum, glowing with a blue light. The Great Crystal of Atlantis feeds on them. Queen Néréa is waiting for three.
textes.Une petite clochette de laiton au bout d: A little brass bell on the end of a green ribbon. When you shake it, somewhere, a little pig pricks up its ears.
textes.Une petite clochette forgée par Ursule e: A little bell forged by Ursule and tempered in the mist. It rings clearer than all the bells on the island.
textes.Une petite clé de fer à l'anneau en trèf: A small iron key with a clover-shaped ring. It opens one locked chest (only once: it stays in the lock).
textes.Une petite fiole d'huile ambrée, à l'ode: A small vial of amber oil, smelling of burnt wood and vanilla: Tiburce, the polisher, rubs it on his customers' horns until they shine like mirrors.
textes.Une petite lanterne d'argent et de verre: A small lantern of silver and glass, entrusted to you by Faelar. The firefly spirits of Bois-Doré can shelter inside it. Bring them back to the door of the Mother Tree.
textes.Une petite pièce de bronze, usée, une ba: A small worn bronze coin with a boat engraved on it. The fare to cross the Acheron: Charon, the ferryman, accepts nothing else (and he counts).
textes.Une pierre lourde veinée de rouille, ram: A heavy stone veined with rust, picked up on the slopes of the volcano. Borin the blacksmith makes steel from it.
textes.Une pierre plate peinte à l'ocre rouge e: A flat stone painted with red ochre and chalk: it's you, as seen by Ocre, the Clan's painter. You're all square. Ocre put yellow around your head, "because you shine".
textes.Une pierre rouge qui brille comme une br: A red stone that glows like an ember. Octave buys it for 30 coins.
textes.Une plume brune et douce, laissée sur le: A soft brown feather, left on Mother Sauge's roof by the owl from the Twisted Wood that you healed.
textes.Une plume de chouette argentée, tombée u: A silvery owl feather, fallen on a full-moon night. In Ramure, every night is a full-moon night.
textes.Une plume longue comme un bras, d'un ver: A feather as long as an arm, of a green that shifts to blue and gold: a feather of the Feathered Serpent, the god of wind and knowledge. Brought back from beneath the Great Temple of Aztlán. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
A bright red apple fallen from a tree. Restores one heart.
textes.Une râpe à fromage en laiton doré, gravé: A gilded brass cheese grater, engraved with a crossed fork and spoon. Captain Rigatoni buried it on the beach thirty years ago, "so nobody would steal it". It still smells a little of parmesan.
textes.Une résine d'arbre jaune pâle, qui brûle: A pale yellow tree resin that burns with a white, fragrant smoke: the incense of the Aztecs, the offering to the sun Huitzilopochtli. Tochtli sells it at the Aztlán market.
textes.Une selle de cuir et de bronze, forgée à: A saddle of leather and bronze, forged in Forgefer for the eagle riders of old. King Thorgal entrusted it to you: Ventaile, the last of the great eagles, nests on the edge of the crater.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée d'une tête: A stone tablet carved with a jaguar's head and four dots: 4 Jaguar, the Sun of the Jaguars, the first of the five suns.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée de flammes: A stone tablet carved with flames falling from the sky and four dots: 4 Rain, the Sun of Fire-rain.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée de vagues: A stone tablet carved with waves and four dots: 4 Water, the Sun of the Water, the sun of the great flood.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée du masque: A stone tablet carved with the mask of Ehécatl, the wind beak, and four dots: 4 Wind, the Sun of the Wind.
textes.Une tasse de porcelaine qui remue son th: A porcelain cup that stirs its own tea, thanks to a little motor hidden in the handle.
textes.Une tisane parfumée aux fleurs de nuit,: A tea scented with night flowers, still warm. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Une touffe d'herbe argentée, cueillie au: A tuft of silvery grass, picked at the water's edge in the Drowned Marsh. The Doc makes his remedy for marsh fever with it.
textes.Une truffe noire et parfumée, déterrée p: A black, fragrant truffle, dug up by Truffe the pig (yes, his name means truffle, and he lives up to it). It smells like the forest after the rain. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une vieille pièce d'or frappée d'une cou: An old gold coin stamped with a crown. Octave gives 12 copper coins for it.
textes.Une vieille puce vocale, grosse comme un: An old voice chip, the size of a stamp, with golden legs and a yellowed label: "Z SERIES — VOICE No. 0". They haven't been made for thirty years. Cargo had kept it, just in case.
textes.Une écaille du Serpent des Abysses, vert: A scale from the Serpent of the Abyss, green and hard as jade, as wide as a hand. Proof of your victory. Octave would give a fortune for it.
textes.Une épée d'entraînement taillée à la for: A training sword carved at the forge. Damage: 3.
textes.Une épée taillée dans un éclat du crista: A sword cut from a shard of the Stoneheart crystal, given by the soothed Guardian. It is warm, and beats softly, like a heart. Damage: 9.
textes.Une étoile de mer orange du fond de la b: An orange starfish from the bottom of Port-Azur bay. It tickles a little.
textes.Vaincre Vieille-Dent, le crocodile géant: Defeat Vieille-Dent, the giant crocodile, deep in the Drowned Marsh (west of the island, under the dead mangroves)
textes.Vaincre la Naga des profondeurs: Defeat the Naga of the depths
textes.Vaincre le Titan de Givre au fond du Coc: Defeat the Frost Titan at the bottom of the Cocytus
textes.Vaincre le chef des gobelins dans son ca: Defeat the goblin chief in his camp, deep in the Goblin Wood (in the north-east of the island, past the East Gate)
textes.Vaincre les jaguars des pentes du Mont F: Defeat the jaguars on the slopes of the Smoking Mountain (west of the island, under the pines)
textes.Vanille, fraise et coco : la spéciale Br: Vanilla, strawberry and coconut: Bruno's special. It melts faster than you can eat it. Restores one heart.
textes.Venir au Festival du Larsen, le soir (à: Come to the Larsen Festival in the evening (from 8:30 p.m.) and join the crowd in front of the Main Stage
textes.Venir au Grand Boucan, le grand concert: Come to the Great Boucan, the Bilge Rats' big concert, in the evening (from 9 p.m.) at the Howling Hall, and dance in the pit
textes.Verser le pot de brun dans son godet (le: Pour the pot of brown into its slot (no. 5): E in front of the Stone Palette, in the middle of the clearing
textes.Verser une première couleur dans la Pale: Pour a first colour into the Stone Palette
textes.Versé de haut, mousseux, très sucré, à l: Poured from up high, frothy, very sweet, with fresh mint from the Fondouk garden. Restores one heart.
textes.Vide. Gâchette près d'un objet pour le r: Empty. Trigger near an item to pick it up.
textes.Vieille-Dent, le crocodile géant du Mara: Vieille-Dent, the giant crocodile of the Drowned Marsh, took Crochet's hand years ago. Crochet wants someone to settle the score.
textes.Vieille-Dent… tu veux qu'on t'en débarra: Vieille-Dent… want us to get rid of him for you?
textes.Violette, la jeune mage de la Guilde, ne: Violette, the Guild's young mage, can only cast lightning bolts, and they often hit her instead. According to an old book, three storm crystals, which grow at the top of the Fangs, would channel her lightning "forwards".
textes.Violette, vos cheveux… ils se dressent t: Violette, your hair… it's standing up all by itself.
textes.Visez avec la main droite, gâchette pour: Aim with your right hand, trigger to click, stick to scroll
textes.Visez un objet et appuyez sur la gâchett: Aim at an item and press the trigger, then “Use” or “Drop”
textes.Voir l'automate joueur d'échecs d'Ambroi: See Ambroise Échec's chess-playing automaton (Fair stand, to the south)
textes.Voir la Cascade Arrabbiata tomber dans l: See the Arrabbiata Falls pour into the sea
textes.Voir la Cascade d'Encre tomber de la fal: See the Ink Waterfall tumble from the cliff
textes.Voir le volcan cracher sa sauce: See the volcano spit out its sauce
textes.Voir nager les carpes de la Place des Ho: Watch the carp swim in the Hologram Square
textes.Vos livres envolés… je peux aider ?: Your runaway books… can I help?
textes.Vos navets… ils bougent, Père Gaubert ?: Your turnips… are they moving, Père Gaubert?
textes.Votre atelier n'a plus de toit ?: Your workshop has lost its roof?
textes.Votre phare a un problème ?: Is something wrong with your lighthouse?
You look rushed off your feet.
textes.Vous pourriez m'apprendre à soigner ?: Could you teach me to heal?
textes.Xóchitl, la jardinière des chinampas, a: Xóchitl, the gardener of the chinampas, needs five bouquets of cempasúchil, the orange flowers that guide the souls of the dead, for the temple altars.
textes.Yggdrasil, l'Arbre-Monde, ne donne plus: Yggdrasil, the World Tree, hasn't produced any seeds for a hundred years: nasty plants have overrun its trunk. Queen Oriane would like the seed sleeping at the very top of the tree.
textes.Yvon, le pêcheur du lac, a peur des gren: Yvon, the lake fisherman, has been afraid of the giant frogs for forty years. There are more and more of them: they steal his fish, his bait and, once, his boat. He'd like someone to chase a few of them away.
textes.Zigomar, l'inventeur et artificier, n'a: Zigomar, the inventor and fireworks maker, has run out of sulphur for his Night of Lanterns rockets. He needs three sulphur crystals from the hot springs.
textes.Zohra, la poissonnière, veut faire son g: Zohra, the fishmonger, wants to make her big Friday tagine. She needs two fine sea bream, caught by someone other than the fish-market men.
textes.Zéphyrine Plume m'apprendra la lévitatio: Zéphyrine Plume will teach me levitation if I bring her three wind feathers. Then I'll have to ring the bell at the top of the Leaning Tower.
textes.Zéro, le vieux balayeur de la Place des: Zéro, the old sweeper of the Hologram Square and the very first android of Neopolis, has lost his voice: his Z-Series voice chip gave out, and they stopped making them thirty years ago. Little Mio, his best friend, would so love to hear him tell his stories again.
textes.approchez un ponton ou une plage pour dé: get close to a pier or a beach to go ashore
textes.l'Autel des Trois Soleils: the Altar of the Three Suns
textes.la carte des Récifs de Feu: the map of the Fire Reefs
textes.la clé de la Baleine Rouillée: the key to the Baleine Rouillée
textes.la tour en ruine des Crocs: the ruined tower of the Fangs
textes.le Donjon des Mille Marches: the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.le cratère du Grand Brasier: the crater of the Great Blaze
textes.le parvis du Temple-Passoire: the forecourt of the Colander Temple
textes.le titre de propriété de la Chaumière: the property deed to the Cottage
textes.les Ruines de l'Ancien Pandémonium: the Ruins of the Old Pandemonium
textes.un éclat du Cœur de la Flèche: a shard of the Spire's Heart
textes.Ça ne sent pas la soupe, aujourd'hui: It doesn't smell of soup today
textes.Ça ne sent pas la soupe, aujourd'hui…: It doesn't smell of soup today…
textes.Ébène dit que Cerbère adore les gâteaux: Ébène says Cerbère loves honey cakes
Ébène says Cerbère loves honey cakes…
textes.Écouter Rachid, le marchand de tapis du: Listen to Rachid, the carpet seller of the Tazira souk, talk about the carpet of stars
textes.Écouter le Vieux Corentin, le conteur de: Listen to Old Corentin, the storyteller of Carène (on the deck of the Léviathan, or at La Dernière Bordée in the evening)
textes.Écouter le piano mécanique de Prudence T: Listen to Prudence Touche's mechanical piano (Fair stand, west side)
textes.Énigmes, gardiens, portes, quêtes, coffr: Riddles, guardians, doors, quests, hidden chests: the hero grows by overcoming them.
textes.Établir un record au parcours d'anneaux: Set a record on the ring course in the Zero-Gravity Garden
textes.Île de Braise, l'Arène des Cornes: Ember Island, the Arena of Horns
textes.Île de Braise, la poste du port: Ember Island, the harbour post office
textes.Île de Montjoie, le Donjon des Mille Mar: Montjoie Island, the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps
textes.Île du Boucan, l'imprimerie de la Filatu: Boucan Island, the Spinning Mill print shop
